```html
<script>
  // Coordinadoras oficiales de Capítulo Uno y Dos · Lima (Directorio Global)
  var COORDS = {
    joyce: { tel:"51933599903", nombre:"Joyce" },
    dina:  { tel:"51912379744", nombre:"Dina" }
  };
  function waLink(c){
    var msg = "Hola "+c.nombre+", vengo de la página de Crear Poder Sin Límites y quiero información sobre los entrenamientos en Lima y reservar mi lugar.";
    return "https://wa.me/"+c.tel+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(msg);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.wa-joyce').forEach(function(a){ a.href = waLink(COORDS.joyce); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.wa-dina').forEach(function(a){ a.href = waLink(COORDS.dina); });

  (function(){
    var c = document.getElementById('field'); if(!c) return;
    var ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
    var pts = [], W=0, H=0, raf=0;
    function size(){
      var r = c.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      W = r.width; H = r.height;
      c.width = W*dpr; c.height = H*dpr; ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
      var n = Math.max(28, Math.min(66, Math.round(W*H/25000)));
      pts = [];
      for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
        pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.28,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.28,r:Math.random()*1.6+.6,cy:Math.random()<.22});
      }
    }
    function draw(){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
      for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){var p=pts[i];
        for(var j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){var q=pts[j],dx=p.x-q.x,dy=p.y-q.y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          if(d<12000){ctx.globalAlpha=(1-d/12000)*.16;ctx.strokeStyle=(p.cy||q.cy)?'#3bbced':'#e6bb52';ctx.lineWidth=.6;
            ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineTo(q.x,q.y);ctx.stroke();}}}
      for(var k=0;k<pts.length;k++){var pt=pts[k];ctx.globalAlpha=.75;ctx.fillStyle=pt.cy?'#3bbced':'#e6bb52';
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.r,0,6.2832);ctx.fill();}
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    }
    function step(){for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){var p=pts[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
      if(p.x<0||p.x>W)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>H)p.vy*=-1;}draw();raf=requestAnimationFrame(step);}
    function start(){size();if(reduce){draw();}else{cancelAnimationFrame(raf);step();}}
    var t;window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(t);t=setTimeout(start,180);});
    start();
  })();
```

```js
export const TRAINER_CALENDAR_SYNC_AGENT_ID = 'agente-sincronizador-asignador-calendario';
export const TRAINER_CALENDAR_SYNC_AGENT_NAME = 'Agente Guardián de Sincronización Asignador ↔ Calendario Global';

export const ORDERED_ASSIGNMENT_SLOTS = ['unico', 'Creación', 'Relación', 'Gratitud'];

export function normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(sede = '') {
  const raw = String(sede || '').trim();
  const clean = raw.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  if (raw === 'MED' || clean.includes('medell')) return 'Medellín';
  if (raw === 'LIM' || clean.includes('lima')) return 'Lima';
  if (raw === 'CUE' || clean.includes('cuenca')) return 'Cuenca';
  if (raw === 'GYE' || clean.includes('guayaquil')) return 'Guayaquil';
  if (raw === 'MEX' || clean.includes('mex') || clean.includes('cdmx')) return 'México';
  if (
    raw === 'UIO-C1' ||
    raw === 'UIO-C2' ||
    raw === 'UIO' ||
    raw.startsWith('UIO') ||
    clean.includes('uio') ||
    clean.includes('quito') ||
    clean.includes('ciclo 1') ||
    clean.includes('ciclo 2')
  ) {
    return 'Quito';
  }
  if (raw === 'INT' || clean.includes('intern')) return 'Internacional';
  if (clean.includes('global')) return 'Sede Global';
  return raw || 'Sede Global';
}

export function normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(equipo = '') {
  if (equipo === null || equipo === undefined) return '';
  let raw = String(equipo).trim();
  if (!raw) return '';
  if (/^\d+\.0+$/.test(raw)) {
    raw = raw.split('.')[0];
  }
  return raw;
}

export function extractTeamDigitsKey(equipo = '') {
  const cleaned = normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(equipo);
  if (!cleaned) return '';
  let digits = cleaned.match(/\d+/g);
  if (!digits || digits.length === 0) return cleaned.toUpperCase();
  if (digits.length === 1 && (digits[0].length === 4 || digits[0].length === 6)) {
    const rawNum = digits[0];
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rawNum.length; i += 2) {
      chunks.push(rawNum.slice(i, i + 2));
    }
    digits = chunks;
  }
  const sortedUnique = [...new Set(digits)].sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
  return sortedUnique.join('');
}

export function normalizeTrainingNameKey(nombre = '') {
  return String(nombre || '')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

export function ajustarFechaFinCalendario(nombre = '', inicioRaw = '', finRaw = '') {
  if (!inicioRaw) return finRaw || '';
  const n = String(nombre || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

  const unSoloDia = [
    'tanque',
    'rompimiento',
    'caida',
    'confianza',
    'caminata',
    'fuego',
    'impacto',
    'revision',
    'revisacion',
  ];
  if (unSoloDia.some(kw => n.includes(kw))) return inicioRaw;

  const terminaDomingo = [
    'capitulo uno',
    'capitulo 1',
    'c1',
    'capitulo dos',
    'capitulo 2',
    'c2',
    'maestria',
    'mj',
    'creacion',
    'relacion',
    'gratitud',
    'viaje',
    'confesiones',
  ];
  if (!terminaDomingo.some(kw => n.includes(kw))) return finRaw || inicioRaw;

  const partes = String(inicioRaw).slice(0, 10).split('-');
  if (partes.length !== 3) return finRaw || inicioRaw;
  const d = new Date(parseInt(partes[0], 10), parseInt(partes[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(partes[2], 10));
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return finRaw || inicioRaw;
  const diff = d.getDay() === 0 ? 0 : 7 - d.getDay();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const time = String(inicioRaw).includes('T') ? String(inicioRaw).substring(10) : 'T00:00:00';
  return `${y}-${m}-${dd}${time}`;
}

export function buildAsignadorEventKey(ev = {}, sedeFallback = '') {
  const f = String(ev.fecha_inicio || ev.start || ev.fechaInicio || '').slice(0, 10);
  const s = normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(ev.sede || ev.sedeTag || sedeFallback || '');
  const n = String(ev.nombre || ev.name || ev.entrenamiento || '').trim();
  const eq = normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(ev.equipo ?? ev.team ?? '');
  return `${f}__${s}__${n}${eq ? '__' + eq : ''}`.replace(/\//g, '-');
}

export function buildAsignadorEventKeyNoTeam(ev = {}, sedeFallback = '') {
  const f = String(ev.fecha_inicio || ev.start || ev.fechaInicio || '').slice(0, 10);
  const s = normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(ev.sede || ev.sedeTag || sedeFallback || '');
  const n = String(ev.nombre || ev.name || ev.entrenamiento || '').trim();
  return `${f}__${s}__${n}`.replace(/\//g, '-');
}

export function mergeOfficialCalendar(apiEvents = [], sheetEvents = []) {
  const keyFor = event => [
    String(event.fecha_inicio || event.start || '').slice(0, 10),
    normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(event.sede || event.sedeTag),
    normalizeTrainingNameKey(event.nombre || event.name),
    extractTeamDigitsKey(event.equipo ?? event.team),
  ].join('__');
  const byKey = new Map(apiEvents.map(event => [keyFor(event), event]));
  for (const event of sheetEvents) {
    const key = keyFor(event);
    const previous = byKey.get(key);
    byKey.set(key, {
      ...previous,
      ...event,
      fecha_fin: previous?.fecha_fin || previous?.end || event.fecha_fin || event.end || '',
      ticket: previous?.ticket || 'pending',
      hotel: previous?.hotel || 'pending',
      notified: previous?.notified || false,
      arrival: previous?.arrival || '',
      ticket_url: previous?.ticket_url || '',
    });
  }
  return [...byKey.values()];
}

export function buildCanonicalEventKeys(ev = {}, sedeFallback = '') {
  const f = String(ev.fecha_inicio || ev.start || ev.fechaInicio || '').slice(0, 10);
  const s = normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(ev.sede || ev.sedeTag || sedeFallback || '');
  const nRaw = String(ev.nombre || ev.name || ev.entrenamiento || '').trim();
  const nNorm = normalizeTrainingNameKey(nRaw);
  const eqRaw = normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(ev.equipo ?? ev.team ?? '');
  const eqDigits = extractTeamDigitsKey(eqRaw);

  const keys = [];
  if (ev.__sourceEventKey) keys.push(String(ev.__sourceEventKey));
  if (ev.sourceEventKey) keys.push(String(ev.sourceEventKey));
  if (ev.__assignmentKey) keys.push(String(ev.__assignmentKey));
  if (ev.id) keys.push(String(ev.id));

  if (f && s && nRaw) {
    if (eqRaw) keys.push(`${f}__${s}__${nRaw}__${eqRaw}`.replace(/\//g, '-'));
    if (eqDigits) keys.push(`${f}__${s}__${nNorm}__${eqDigits}`.replace(/\//g, '-'));
    keys.push(`${f}__${s}__${nRaw}`.replace(/\//g, '-'));
    keys.push(`${f}__${s}__${nNorm}`.replace(/\//g, '-'));
  }

  return [...new Set(keys.filter(Boolean))];
}

export function extractConfirmedSlotsFromAssignment(assignment = {}) {
  if (!assignment || typeof assignment !== 'object') return [];
  return ORDERED_ASSIGNMENT_SLOTS
    .filter(slot => assignment[slot]?.entrenador && String(assignment[slot].entrenador).trim())
    .map(slot => ({
      slot,
      entrenador: String(assignment[slot].entrenador).trim(),
      fechaIso: String(assignment[slot].fechaIso || ''),
    }));
}

export function extractConfirmedTrainerFromAssignment(assignment = {}, formatDisplayFn = null) {
  const confirmedSlots = extractConfirmedSlotsFromAssignment(assignment);
  const format = typeof formatDisplayFn === 'function' ? formatDisplayFn : (v => String(v || '').trim());
  if (confirmedSlots.length > 0) {
    if (confirmedSlots.length === 1 && confirmedSlots[0].slot === 'unico') {
      return format(confirmedSlots[0].entrenador);
    }
    return confirmedSlots
      .map(item => `${item.slot === 'unico' ? '' : `${item.slot}: `}${format(item.entrenador)}`)
      .join(' / ');
  }
  const direct = String(assignment?.entrenador || assignment?.trainer || '').trim();
  return direct ? format(direct) : '';
}

export function indexAssignmentsForLookup(assignments = []) {
  const list = Array.isArray(assignments)
    ? assignments
    : Object.entries(assignments || {}).map(([id, data]) => ({ id, ...(data || {}) }));
  return { assignments: list.filter(item => item && typeof item === 'object') };
}

export function matchAssignmentForEvent(ev = {}, assignmentIndex, sedeFallback = '') {
  if (!assignmentIndex) return null;
  const f = String(ev.fecha_inicio || ev.start || ev.fechaInicio || '').slice(0, 10);
  const s = normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(ev.sede || ev.sedeTag || sedeFallback || '');
  const nRaw = String(ev.nombre || ev.name || ev.entrenamiento || '').trim();
  const nNorm = normalizeTrainingNameKey(nRaw);
  const eqRaw = normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(ev.equipo ?? ev.team ?? '');
  const eqDigits = extractTeamDigitsKey(eqRaw);

  // Un vínculo explícito conserva la identidad aunque el Asignador cambie fecha,
  // sede o equipo. Sin vínculo, todos los campos deben coincidir.
  const ids = [ev.__assignmentKey, ev.__sourceEventKey, ev.sourceEventKey, ev.id].filter(Boolean);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const linked = assignmentIndex.assignments.filter(item => item.id === id);
    if (linked.length === 1) return linked[0];
  }
  const candidates = assignmentIndex.assignments.filter(item => {
    return f && nNorm &&
      String(item.fechaInicio || item.fecha_inicio || item.start || '').slice(0, 10) === f &&
      normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(item.sede || item.sedeTag || '') === s &&
      normalizeTrainingNameKey(item.entrenamiento || item.nombre || item.name || '') === nNorm;
  });
  const exact = candidates.filter(item => extractTeamDigitsKey(item.equipo ?? item.team ?? '') === eqDigits);
  if (exact.length === 1) return exact[0];
  if (candidates.length !== 1) return null;
  const team = extractTeamDigitsKey(candidates[0].equipo ?? candidates[0].team ?? '');
  return !eqDigits || !team || eqDigits === team ? candidates[0] : null;
}

export function calendarEventsForLocalDay(events = [], date) {
  const day = `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  return events.filter(event => {
    const start = String(event.fecha_inicio || event.start || event.fechaInicio || event.startDate || event.date || '').slice(0, 10);
    const end = String(event.fecha_fin || event.end || event.fechaFin || event.endDate || start).slice(0, 10);
    return Boolean(start) && day >= start && day <= end;
  });
}

/**
 * Proyección autoritativa del Asignador de Entrenadores sobre los eventos del calendario.
 * Regla de oro:
 * - `/asignador-entrenadores` es la ÚNICA fuente de verdad para `trainer` / `entrenador` y overrides de fechas.
 * - El entrenador que venía en la hoja de Google se conserva únicamente en `sheetTrainer`
 *   como referencia/sugerencia para el selector del Asignador, NUNCA como entrenador confirmado.
 */
export function applyAsignadorAuthoritativeProjection(sourceEventsOrOptions = [], assignmentsArg = [], operationalChangesArg = []) {
  let sourceEvents = sourceEventsOrOptions;
  let assignments = assignmentsArg;
  let operationalChanges = operationalChangesArg;
  if (
    sourceEventsOrOptions &&
    !Array.isArray(sourceEventsOrOptions) &&
    typeof sourceEventsOrOptions === 'object'
  ) {
    sourceEvents = sourceEventsOrOptions.rawEvents || sourceEventsOrOptions.sourceEvents || [];
    assignments = sourceEventsOrOptions.assignments || [];
    if (Array.isArray(sourceEventsOrOptions.operationalChanges)) {
      operationalChanges = sourceEventsOrOptions.operationalChanges;
    } else {
      const ovList = Object.entries(sourceEventsOrOptions.overrides || {}).map(([id, val]) => ({
        id,
        kind: 'override',
        sourceEventKey: val?.sourceEventKey || id,
        ...(val || {}),
      }));
      const custList = (sourceEventsOrOptions.customEvents || []).map(item => ({
        kind: 'custom',
        ...(item || {}),
      }));
      operationalChanges = [...ovList, ...custList];
    }
  }
  operationalChanges = normalizeOperationalChanges(operationalChanges || []);
  const assignmentIndex = indexAssignmentsForLookup(assignments);

  const overridesBySourceKey = new Map();
  const customByKey = new Map();
  const sourceCounts = new Map();
  for (const event of sourceEvents || []) {
    const key = buildAsignadorEventKeyNoTeam(event);
    sourceCounts.set(key, (sourceCounts.get(key) || 0) + 1);
  }
  for (const item of operationalChanges || []) {
    if (item?.kind === 'override' && (item.sourceEventKey || item.id)) {
      const k = String(item.sourceEventKey || item.id);
      overridesBySourceKey.set(k, item);
    }
    if (item?.kind === 'custom' && item.id) customByKey.set(String(item.id), item);
  }

  const result = (sourceEvents || []).map(event => {
    const sourceKey = event.__sourceEventKey || event.sourceEventKey || buildAsignadorEventKey(event);
    const sourceKeyNoTeam = buildAsignadorEventKeyNoTeam(event);
    const noTeamCount = sourceCounts.get(sourceKeyNoTeam);
    const override = customByKey.get(sourceKey) || overridesBySourceKey.get(sourceKey) ||
      (noTeamCount === 1 ? overridesBySourceKey.get(sourceKeyNoTeam) : null);

    const rawSheetTrainer =
      typeof event.sheetTrainer !== 'undefined'
        ? event.sheetTrainer
        : String(event.trainer || event.entrenador || '').trim();

    const nombreFinal = override?.nombre || event.nombre || event.name || '';
    const inicioFinal = override?.fechaInicio || event.fecha_inicio || event.start || event.fechaInicio || '';
    const finBase = override?.fechaFin || event.fecha_fin || event.end || event.fechaFin || '';
    const finFinal = override?.fechaFin || ajustarFechaFinCalendario(nombreFinal, inicioFinal, finBase);

    const updatedEvent = {
      ...event,
      __sourceEventKey: sourceKey,
      __assignmentKey: event.__assignmentKey || sourceKey,
      sheetTrainer: rawSheetTrainer,
      ...(override
        ? {
            nombre: nombreFinal,
            name: nombreFinal,
            sede: override.sede || event.sede,
            sedeTag: override.sede || event.sedeTag,
            equipo: override.equipo ?? event.equipo,
            lugar: override.lugar ?? event.lugar,
            fecha_inicio: inicioFinal,
            fecha_fin: finFinal,
            start: inicioFinal,
            end: finFinal,
          }
        : {
            fecha_fin: finFinal,
            end: finFinal,
          }),
    };

    const assignmentDoc =
      matchAssignmentForEvent(updatedEvent, assignmentIndex) ||
      matchAssignmentForEvent(event, assignmentIndex);
    if (assignmentDoc) {
      updatedEvent.__assignmentKey = assignmentDoc.id || sourceKey;
      const start = override?.fechaInicio || assignmentDoc.fechaInicio || inicioFinal;
      const end = override?.fechaFin || assignmentDoc.fechaFin || finFinal;
      Object.assign(updatedEvent, {
        nombre: override?.nombre || assignmentDoc.entrenamiento || nombreFinal,
        name: override?.nombre || assignmentDoc.entrenamiento || nombreFinal,
        sede: override?.sede || assignmentDoc.sede || updatedEvent.sede,
        sedeTag: override?.sede || assignmentDoc.sede || updatedEvent.sedeTag,
        equipo: override?.equipo ?? assignmentDoc.equipo ?? updatedEvent.equipo,
        fecha_inicio: start, start,
        fecha_fin: end, end,
      });
    }

    const confirmedTrainer = extractConfirmedTrainerFromAssignment(assignmentDoc);

    if (confirmedTrainer) {
      updatedEvent.trainer = confirmedTrainer;
      updatedEvent.entrenador = confirmedTrainer;
      updatedEvent.confirmedTrainer = confirmedTrainer;
      updatedEvent.assignmentSource = 'causa_os';
      updatedEvent.__assignmentKey = assignmentDoc?.id || sourceKey;
    } else {
      // Estricto cumplimiento: si no está asignado en /asignador-entrenadores, no inventar ni heredar de Sheets como confirmado
      updatedEvent.trainer = '';
      updatedEvent.entrenador = '';
      updatedEvent.confirmedTrainer = '';
      updatedEvent.assignmentSource = 'unassigned_in_asignador';
      updatedEvent.__assignmentKey = assignmentDoc?.id || sourceKey;
    }

    return updatedEvent;
  });

  for (const item of (operationalChanges || []).filter(it => it?.kind === 'custom' && it.fechaInicio && it.nombre)) {
    const customKey = String(item.sourceEventKey || String(item.id).replace(/^custom__/, ''));
    if (result.some(event => event.__sourceEventKey === customKey)) continue;
    const finFinal = item.fechaFin || ajustarFechaFinCalendario(item.nombre, item.fechaInicio, '');
    const customEvent = {
      __sourceEventKey: customKey,
      __assignmentKey: customKey,
      id: customKey,
      fecha_inicio: item.fechaInicio,
      fecha_fin: finFinal,
      start: item.fechaInicio,
      end: finFinal,
      nombre: item.nombre,
      name: item.nombre,
      sede: item.sede,
      sedeTag: item.sede,
      equipo: item.equipo || '',
      lugar: item.lugar || '',
      direccion: '',
      sheetTrainer: '',
      trainer: '',
      entrenador: '',
      confirmedTrainer: '',
      assignmentSource: 'unassigned_in_asignador',
      origen: 'causa_os',
      esPersonalizado: true,
    };
    const assignmentDoc = matchAssignmentForEvent(customEvent, assignmentIndex);
    const confirmedTrainer = extractConfirmedTrainerFromAssignment(assignmentDoc);
    if (confirmedTrainer) {
      customEvent.trainer = confirmedTrainer;
      customEvent.entrenador = confirmedTrainer;
      customEvent.confirmedTrainer = confirmedTrainer;
      customEvent.assignmentSource = 'causa_os';
    }
    result.push(customEvent);
  }

  // Un equipo vacío no identifica a ninguno de los equipos paralelos.
  const deduplicated = [];
  const seenByBaseKey = new Map();

  for (const ev of result) {
    const d = String(ev.fecha_inicio || ev.start || '').slice(0, 10);
    const s = normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(ev.sede || ev.sedeTag || '').toUpperCase();
    const n = normalizeTrainingNameKey(ev.nombre || ev.name || '');
    const eqDigits = extractTeamDigitsKey(ev.equipo || ev.team || '');
    const baseKey = `${d}__${s}__${n}`;

    if (!seenByBaseKey.has(baseKey)) {
      seenByBaseKey.set(baseKey, [ev]);
      deduplicated.push(ev);
      continue;
    }

    const candidates = seenByBaseKey.get(baseKey);
    const matchingExisting = candidates.find(existing => {
      const existingEqDigits = extractTeamDigitsKey(existing.equipo || existing.team || '');
      return existingEqDigits === eqDigits;
    });

    if (!matchingExisting) {
      candidates.push(ev);
      deduplicated.push(ev);
    } else {
      if (ev.assignmentSource === 'causa_os' && matchingExisting.assignmentSource !== 'causa_os') {
        const preservedEquipo = matchingExisting.equipo || ev.equipo;
        const preservedSheetTrainer = matchingExisting.sheetTrainer || ev.sheetTrainer;
        Object.assign(matchingExisting, ev, {
          equipo: ev.equipo || preservedEquipo,
          sheetTrainer: preservedSheetTrainer,
        });
      } else {
        matchingExisting.equipo = matchingExisting.equipo || ev.equipo;
        matchingExisting.lugar = matchingExisting.lugar || ev.lugar;
        matchingExisting.direccion = matchingExisting.direccion || ev.direccion;
        matchingExisting.sheetTrainer = matchingExisting.sheetTrainer || ev.sheetTrainer;
        if (!matchingExisting.trainer && ev.assignmentSource === 'causa_os' && ev.trainer) {
          matchingExisting.trainer = ev.trainer;
          matchingExisting.entrenador = ev.entrenador;
          matchingExisting.confirmedTrainer = ev.confirmedTrainer;
          matchingExisting.assignmentSource = 'causa_os';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return deduplicated.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.fecha_inicio || a.start) - new Date(b.fecha_inicio || b.start));
}

function serializeSlotMap(docData = {}) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    ORDERED_ASSIGNMENT_SLOTS.map(slot => {
      const val = docData?.[slot];
      return [
        slot,
        val?.entrenador && String(val.entrenador).trim()
          ? {
              entrenador: String(val.entrenador).trim(),
              fechaIso: String(val.fechaIso || ''),
            }
          : null,
      ];
    })
  );
}

export function buildPublicAssignment(assignment = {}) {
  return {
    entrenamiento: String(assignment.entrenamiento || ''),
    sede: normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(assignment.sede || ''),
    fechaInicio: String(assignment.fechaInicio || ''),
    fechaFin: assignment.fechaFin ||
      ajustarFechaFinCalendario(assignment.entrenamiento || '', assignment.fechaInicio || '', '') || null,
    equipo: normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(assignment.equipo) || null,
    ...serializeSlotMap(assignment),
    source: 'causa_os_asignador',
    syncedByAgent: TRAINER_CALENDAR_SYNC_AGENT_ID,
  };
}

export function buildPublicOperational(value = {}, kind = 'override', id = '') {
  return {
    kind,
    sourceEventKey: kind === 'override' ? String(value.sourceEventKey || id) : null,
    nombre: String(value.nombre || ''),
    sede: normalizeTrainerCalendarSede(value.sede || ''),
    equipo: normalizeTrainerCalendarTeam(value.equipo),
    lugar: String(value.lugar || ''),
    fechaInicio: String(value.fechaInicio || ''),
    fechaFin: String(value.fechaFin || ajustarFechaFinCalendario(value.nombre || '', value.fechaInicio || '', '')),
    source: 'causa_os_asignador',
  };
}

export function normalizeOperationalChanges(changes = []) {
  const byId = new Map();
  for (const item of changes) {
    const prefix = `${item.kind}__`;
    const rawId = String(item.id || '');
    const id = rawId.startsWith(prefix) ? rawId.slice(prefix.length) : rawId;
    const previous = byId.get(`${item.kind}:${id}`);
    if (!previous || item.id === id) byId.set(`${item.kind}:${id}`, { ...item, id });
  }
  return [...byId.values()];
}

function publicPayloadDiffers(current, expected) {
  if (!current) return true;
  const allowed = new Set([...Object.keys(expected), 'id', 'actualizadoEn', 'publicadoPor']);
  return Object.keys(current).some(key => !allowed.has(key)) ||
    Object.entries(expected).some(([key, value]) => JSON.stringify(current[key] ?? null) !== JSON.stringify(value));
}

/**
 * Calcula qué documentos en `calendario_asignaciones_publicas` y `calendario_operativo_publico`
 * están desincronizados respecto a la fuente canónica `/asignador-entrenadores`.
 */
export function computeCalendarProjectionPlan({
  assignments = {},
  overrides = {},
  customEvents = [],
  publicAssignments = [],
  publicOperational = [],
}) {
  const publicAssignMap = new Map(
    (Array.isArray(publicAssignments)
      ? publicAssignments
      : Object.entries(publicAssignments || {}).map(([id, d]) => ({ id, ...(d || {}) }))
    ).map(item => [String(item.id), item])
  );

  const publicOpMap = new Map(
    (Array.isArray(publicOperational)
      ? publicOperational
      : Object.entries(publicOperational || {}).map(([id, d]) => ({ id, ...(d || {}) }))
    ).map(item => [String(item.id), item])
  );

  const assignmentsToPublish = [];
  const assignmentEntries = Array.isArray(assignments)
    ? assignments.map(item => [String(item.id), item])
    : Object.entries(assignments || {});

  for (const [id, assignment] of assignmentEntries) {
    if (!id || !assignment) continue;
    const expectedPayload = buildPublicAssignment(assignment);
    const currentPublic = publicAssignMap.get(id);
    const needsSync = publicPayloadDiffers(currentPublic, expectedPayload);

    if (needsSync) {
      assignmentsToPublish.push({ id, payload: expectedPayload });
    }
  }

  const canonicalIds = new Set(assignmentEntries.map(([id]) => id));
  for (const [id, current] of publicAssignMap) {
    if (canonicalIds.has(id) || !extractConfirmedTrainerFromAssignment(current)) continue;
    assignmentsToPublish.push({
      id,
      payload: buildPublicAssignment({
        entrenamiento: current.entrenamiento, sede: current.sede,
        fechaInicio: current.fechaInicio, fechaFin: current.fechaFin, equipo: current.equipo,
      }),
    });
  }

  const operationalToPublish = [];
  const overrideEntries = Array.isArray(overrides)
    ? overrides.map(item => [String(item.id), item])
    : Object.entries(overrides || {});

  for (const [id, value] of overrideEntries) {
    if (!id || !value) continue;
    const expectedPayload = buildPublicOperational(value, 'override', id);

    const currentPublic = publicOpMap.get(id);
    const needsSync = publicPayloadDiffers(currentPublic, expectedPayload);

    if (needsSync) operationalToPublish.push({ id, payload: expectedPayload });
    const legacyId = `override__${id}`;
    if (publicOpMap.has(legacyId) && publicPayloadDiffers(publicOpMap.get(legacyId), expectedPayload)) {
      operationalToPublish.push({ id: legacyId, payload: expectedPayload });
    }
  }

  const customList = Array.isArray(customEvents)
    ? customEvents
    : Object.entries(customEvents || {}).map(([id, d]) => ({ id, ...(d || {}) }));

  for (const value of customList) {
    const id = String(value?.id || '').trim();
    if (!id) continue;
    const expectedPayload = buildPublicOperational(value, 'custom', id);

    const currentPublic = publicOpMap.get(id);
    const needsSync = publicPayloadDiffers(currentPublic, expectedPayload);

    if (needsSync) operationalToPublish.push({ id, payload: expectedPayload });
    const legacyId = `custom__${id}`;
    if (publicOpMap.has(legacyId) && publicPayloadDiffers(publicOpMap.get(legacyId), expectedPayload)) {
      operationalToPublish.push({ id: legacyId, payload: expectedPayload });
    }
  }

  return {
    agentId: TRAINER_CALENDAR_SYNC_AGENT_ID,
    inSync: assignmentsToPublish.length === 0 && operationalToPublish.length === 0,
    totalCanonicalAssignments: assignmentEntries.length,
    totalCanonicalOperational: overrideEntries.length + customList.length,
    assignmentsToPublish,
    assignmentsToWrite: assignmentsToPublish,
    operationalToPublish,
    operationalToWrite: operationalToPublish,
  };
}
```

## Archivo: public/officialCalendarSheet.js

```js
export const OFFICIAL_CALENDAR_SHEET_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1u0tc4GeooPmSwNxZ0CErKGtRU4oD-mO3l--ZSQM-KPs/export?format=csv&gid=1326951636';

// CSV preserves mixed numeric/team-cohort cells that Google Visualization drops.
export function parseOfficialCalendarSheet(text) {
  const rows = [];
  let row = [];
  let field = '';
  let quoted = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const character = text[i];
    if (character === '"') {
      if (quoted && text[i + 1] === '"') {
        field += '"';
        i++;
      } else if (quoted || field === '') {
        quoted = !quoted;
      } else {
        throw new Error('Comillas inválidas en el calendario CSV.');
      }
    } else if (!quoted && (character === ',' || character === '\n' || character === '\r')) {
      row.push(field);
      field = '';
      if (character !== ',') {
        rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        if (character === '\r' && text[i + 1] === '\n') i++;
      }
    } else {
      field += character;
    }
  }
  if (quoted) throw new Error('Calendario CSV incompleto.');
  if (field || row.length) rows.push([...row, field]);
  const header = rows.shift()?.map(value => value.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim().toLowerCase());
  if (!header || header[0] !== 'fecha' || header[2] !== 'equipo' ||
      header[3] !== 'entrenamiento' || header.length < 7) {
    throw new Error('Cambió el esquema de la hoja del calendario oficial.');
  }
  return rows.flatMap(cells => {
    if (cells.every(cell => !cell.trim())) return [];
    const start = cells[0]?.trim();
    // Non-event rows in the source may have no date; never infer one.
    if (!start) return [];
    const date = new Date(`${start}T00:00:00Z`);
    if (cells.length !== header.length || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(start) ||
        !Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== start) {
      throw new Error('Fila o fecha inválida en el calendario oficial.');
    }
    return [{
      fecha_inicio: `${start}T00:00:00`, fecha_fin: '',
      sede: cells[1].trim(), equipo: cells[2].trim(), nombre: cells[3].trim(),
      trainer: cells[4].trim(), lugar: cells[5].trim(), direccion: cells[6].trim(),
      source: 'official_sheet_crosscheck'
    }];
  });
}
```

## Archivo: public/officialCalendarSource.js

```js
import { OFFICIAL_CALENDAR_SHEET_URL, parseOfficialCalendarSheet } from './officialCalendarSheet.js';
import { mergeOfficialCalendar } from './trainerCalendarProjection.js';

export const OFFICIAL_CALENDAR_API_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxSZFhddMYyspZpkW-qPHEi8hycLGfnhFeCPSYc4VbckWIeiiZAbxyJY71XRb2-Ya4U/exec?action=getEventos';
export const CALENDAR_CACHE_KEY = 'causa_official_calendar_cache';
export const CALENDAR_REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

async function readSource(url, parse, fetchImpl, timeoutMs, signal) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const abort = () => controller.abort();
  signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
  if (signal?.aborted) controller.abort();
  let timer;
  try {
    return await Promise.race([
      (async () => {
        const response = await fetchImpl(url, { signal: controller.signal, cache: 'no-store' });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
        return await parse(response);
      })(),
      new Promise((_, reject) => {
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
          controller.abort();
          reject(new Error('Tiempo de espera agotado'));
        }, timeoutMs);
      }),
    ]);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
  }
}

export async function loadOfficialCalendar({ fetchImpl = fetch, timeoutMs = 8000, signal } = {}) {
  const [api, sheet] = await Promise.allSettled([
    readSource(OFFICIAL_CALENDAR_API_URL, async response => {
      const json = await response.json();
      const events = json?.data || json;
      if (!Array.isArray(events) || !events.length ||
          events.some(event => !event || !(event.fecha_inicio || event.start))) {
        throw new Error('Respuesta inválida o vacía de Apps Script');
      }
      return events;
    }, fetchImpl, timeoutMs, signal),
    readSource(OFFICIAL_CALENDAR_SHEET_URL, async response => {
      const events = parseOfficialCalendarSheet(await response.text());
      if (!events.length) throw new Error('Hoja oficial sin eventos');
      return events;
    }, fetchImpl, timeoutMs, signal),
  ]);
  const sources = { api: api.status === 'fulfilled', sheet: sheet.status === 'fulfilled' };
  const errors = [api, sheet].flatMap((result, index) => result.status === 'rejected'
    ? [`${index === 0 ? 'Apps Script' : 'Hoja oficial'}: ${result.reason.message}`] : []);
  if (!sources.api && !sources.sheet) throw new Error(errors.join('; '));
  return {
    events: mergeOfficialCalendar(sources.api ? api.value : [], sources.sheet ? sheet.value : [])
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.fecha_inicio || a.start) - new Date(b.fecha_inicio || b.start)),
    sources, errors, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export function readCalendarCache(storage) {
  const raw = storage.getItem(CALENDAR_CACHE_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  // Legacy arrays have no known retrieval time, so never give them a fresh timestamp.
  const events = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : parsed?.events;
  if (!Array.isArray(events) || !events.length ||
      events.some(event => !event || !(event.fecha_inicio || event.start))) {
    throw new Error('Caché del calendario inválida');
  }
  return { events, checkedAt: Array.isArray(parsed) ? null : parsed.checkedAt || null };
}

export function calendarFreshnessText({ refreshing, checkedAt, sources, error, cached } = {}) {
  const timestamp = checkedAt ? new Date(checkedAt).toLocaleString('es') : 'desconocida';
  const previous = `Última lectura: ${timestamp}.`;
  if (refreshing) return `Consultando fuentes del calendario. ${previous}`;
  if (error) return `No se pudo actualizar el calendario. ${cached ? 'Copia local; actualidad no verificada.' : 'Se conservan los datos disponibles, sin verificar actualidad.'} ${previous} ${error}`;
  if (!sources) return `Copia local; actualidad no verificada. ${previous}`;
  if (!sources.sheet) return `Solo Apps Script; no se pudo contrastar la hoja vigente. ${previous}`;
  if (!sources.api) return `Hoja oficial consultada; historial de Apps Script no disponible. ${previous}`;
  return `Hoja oficial y Apps Script consultados. ${previous} Las asignaciones y cambios operativos se leen de Causa OS.`;
}

```

```html
    <div id="reading-assistant" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[999] font-sans">
        
        <!-- Botón Flotante Principal -->
        <button id="assistant-trigger" class="glassmorphism w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-crearCyan shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,210,255,0.3)] hover:text-white hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-all duration-300 relative group cursor-pointer border border-crearBorder/30">
            <!-- Icono del Ojo -->
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-6 h-6 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M2.036 12.322a1.012 1.012 0 010-.639C3.423 7.51 7.36 4.5 12 4.5c4.638 0 8.573 3.007 9.963 7.178.07.207.07.431 0 .639C20.577 16.49 16.64 19.5 12 19.5c-4.638 0-8.573-3.007-9.963-7.178z" />
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
            </svg>
            
            <!-- Badge de Progreso de Lectura -->
            <span id="assistant-badge" class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-crearRed text-white text-[10px] font-black w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border border-crearDarker shadow-md transition-all animate-bounce">0%</span>
        </button>

        <!-- Panel del Asistente -->
        <div id="assistant-panel" class="hidden absolute bottom-16 right-0 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] glassmorphism rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] border border-crearBorder/40 transition-all duration-300">
            <!-- Cabecera -->
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 border-b border-crearBorder/20 pb-3">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="text-crearCyan text-lg">✨</span>
                    <h4 class="text-white font-bold font-outfit text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">Asistente de Lectura</h4>
                </div>
                <button id="assistant-close" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs">
                    ✕
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Garantía de Lectura Obligatoria -->
            <div class="mb-5 bg-crearDark/40 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-crearBorder/10">
                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Lectura Obligatoria</p>
                <div class="space-y-2.5">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-300">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span id="check-step-1" class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold transition-all">✓</span>
                            <span>1. Info Clave y Horarios</span>
                        </span>
                        <span id="status-step-1" class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono transition-colors">Pendiente</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-300">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span id="check-step-2" class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold transition-all">✓</span>
                            <span>2. Ropa Cómoda y Abrigo</span>
                        </span>
                        <span id="status-step-2" class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono transition-colors">Pendiente</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-300">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span id="check-step-3" class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold transition-all">✓</span>
                            <span>3. Normas de Convivencia</span>
                        </span>
                        <span id="status-step-3" class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono transition-colors">Pendiente</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-300">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span id="check-step-4" class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold transition-all">✓</span>
                            <span>4. Compromiso con el Proceso</span>
                        </span>
                        <span id="status-step-4" class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono transition-colors">Pendiente</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Barra de Progreso Interna -->
                <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-crearBorder/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Progreso total:</span>
                    <span id="panel-progress-text" class="text-xs font-black text-crearCyan font-mono">0%</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Herramientas de Bienestar Visual -->
            <div class="space-y-4">
                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Herramientas Visuales</p>
                
                <!-- Regla de Enfoque -->
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                    <span class="text-gray-300">Regla de Enfoque (Luz Láser)</span>

    <!-- INTERACTIVIDAD JS -->
    <script>
        // Generador de Partículas de fondo para el efecto "Cuántico"
        const particlesContainer = document.getElementById('particles-container');
        for(let i=0; i<40; i++) {
            const particle = document.createElement('div');
            particle.className = 'particle';
            
            // Posiciones aleatorias
            const x = Math.random() * 100;
            const y = Math.random() * 100;
            
            // Tamaños aleatorios
            const size = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
            
            // Duraciones y retrasos aleatorios
            const duration = Math.random() * 10 + 10;
            const delay = Math.random() * 5;
            
            particle.style.left = `${x}%`;
            particle.style.top = `${y}%`;
            particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
            particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
            
            // Colores aleatorios (blanco, cyan o dorado)
            const colors = ['rgba(255,255,255,0.3)', 'rgba(0,210,255,0.4)', 'rgba(255,183,3,0.3)'];
            particle.style.background = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
            
            // Animación CSS en línea usando Web Animations API
            particle.animate([
                { transform: 'translate(0,0) scale(1)', opacity: Math.random() * 0.3 },
                { transform: `translate(${(Math.random()-0.5)*150}px, ${(Math.random()-0.5)*150}px) scale(${Math.random()*1.5})`, opacity: Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.2 },
                { transform: 'translate(0,0) scale(1)', opacity: Math.random() * 0.3 }
            ], {
                duration: duration * 1000,
                iterations: Infinity,
                delay: delay * 1000,
                direction: 'alternate',
                easing: 'ease-in-out'
            });
            
            particlesContainer.appendChild(particle);
        }

        // Animación de entrada al hacer scroll (Reveal elements)
        function reveal() {
            const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
            
            for (let i = 0; i < reveals.length; i++) {
                const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
                const elementTop = reveals[i].getBoundingClientRect().top;
                const elementVisible = 100;
                
                if (elementTop < windowHeight - elementVisible) {
                    reveals[i].classList.add('active');
                }
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', reveal);
        // Activar la función una vez al cargar la página para los elementos visibles
        setTimeout(reveal, 100);

        // Extraer parámetros

        const currentSede = sedeConfig[sedeCode] || sedeConfig['LIM'];
        
        // ==========================================
        // RENDERIZAR DATOS DE LA SEDE EN EL DOM
        // ==========================================
        function renderSedeData() {
            // Actualizar Badge de Ciudad y Bandera
            const sedeFlag = document.getElementById('sede-flag');
            const sedeCityName = document.getElementById('sede-city-name');
            if (sedeFlag && sedeCityName && currentSede.countryCode) {
                sedeFlag.src = `https://flagcdn.com/${currentSede.countryCode}.svg`;
                sedeFlag.classList.remove('hidden');

            document.getElementById('hotel-address').innerText = currentSede.hotelAddress;

            document.getElementById('hero-month').innerText = currentSede.heroMonth;

            if (heroMonthMainEl) heroMonthMainEl.innerText = currentSede.heroMonth;
            
            document.getElementById('hotel-name-map').innerText = currentSede.hotelName;
            document.getElementById('hotel-address-map').innerText = currentSede.hotelAddress;
            document.getElementById('hotel-city-map').innerText = currentSede.name;
            
            document.getElementById('map-iframe').src = currentSede.mapSrc;
            document.getElementById('map-link').href = currentSede.mapLink;
            
            const abrigoText = document.getElementById('abrigo-text');
            if (currentSede.coldAC) {
                abrigoText.innerText = `El aire acondicionado de ${currentSede.hotelName} suele estar frío;`;
            } else {
                abrigoText.innerText = `Es posible que la temperatura varíe en el salón;`;
            }
            
            // Generar botones de coordinadores
            const coordContainer = document.getElementById('coordinators-container');
            if (coordContainer) {
                coordContainer.innerHTML = '';
                currentSede.coordinators.forEach(coord => {
                    const waLink = `https://wa.me/${coord.phone}?text=Hola%20${coord.name},%20quiero%20confirmar%20mi%20asistencia%20al%20entrenamiento%20CREAR%20Cap%C3%ADtulo%20Uno`;
                    coordContainer.innerHTML += `
                    <a href="${waLink}" target="_blank" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-[#25D366]/10 hover:bg-[#25D366]/20 border border-[#25D366]/30 text-white px-6 py-4 rounded-xl transition-all group shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,211,102,0.15)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(37,211,102,0.3)]">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-6 h-6 text-[#25D366] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M.057 24l1.687-6.163c-1.041-1.804-1.588-3.849-1.587-5.946.003-6.556 5.338-11.891 11.893-11.891 3.181.001 6.167 1.24 8.413 3.488 2.245 2.248 3.481 5.236 3.48 8.414-.003 6.557-5.338 11.892-11.893 11.892-1.99-.001-3.951-.5-5.688-1.448l-6.305 1.654zm6.597-3.807c1.676.995 3.276 1.591 5.392 1.592 5.448 0 9.886-4.434 9.889-9.885.002-5.462-4.415-9.89-9.881-9.892-5.452 0-9.887 4.434-9.889 9.884-.001 2.225.651 3.891 1.746 5.634l-.999 3.648 3.742-.981zm11.387-5.464c-.074-.124-.272-.198-.57-.347-.297-.149-1.758-.87-2.031-.97-.272-.099-.47-.149-.669.149-.198.297-.768.97-.941 1.168-.173.198-.347.223-.644.074-.297-.149-1.255-.462-2.39-1.305-.88-.653-1.473-1.46-1.646-1.758-.173-.297-.018-.458.13-.606.134-.133.297-.347.446-.52.151-.172.2-.296.3-.495.099-.198.05-.372-.025-.52-.075-.149-.669-1.611-.916-2.206-.242-.579-.487-.501-.669-.51l-.57-.01c-.198 0-.52.074-.792.347-.272.297-1.04 1.016-1.04 2.479 0 1.463 1.065 2.876 1.213 3.074.149.198 2.096 3.2 5.077 4.487.709.306 1.263.489 1.694.626.712.226 1.36.194 1.872.118.571-.085 1.758-.719 2.006-1.413.248-.695.248-1.29.173-1.414z"/></svg>

                            <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[#25D366] font-bold">Coordinadora</p>

            }
            
            // Botón de soporte activo
            const supportBtn = document.getElementById('active-support-btn');
            if (supportBtn) {
                supportBtn.href = `https://wa.me/${currentSede.supportPhone}?text=Ayuda%20necesito%20asistencia%20en%20el%20sal%C3%B3n`;
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // MOTOR DE ESTADO DEL SISTEMA (PRE-TRAINING VS PORTAL ACTIVO)
        // ==========================================
        let targetStartDate = 0;
        let targetTransitionDate = 0;
        
        let currentState = 'PRE-TRAINING'; // 'PRE-TRAINING' | 'TRANSITION' | 'ACTIVE'
        
        function checkSystemState() {
            // Obtenemos la hora actual o el override de pruebas
            let now;
            if (testTimeOverride) {
                now = new Date(testTimeOverride).getTime();
            } else {
                now = new Date().getTime();
            }

            // Actualizar contador del Hero si estamos en Pre-Training
            if (currentState === 'PRE-TRAINING') {
                const diffStart = targetStartDate - now;
                if (diffStart > 0) {
                    const dias = Math.floor(diffStart / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const horas = Math.floor((diffStart % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    document.getElementById('dias').innerText = dias;
                    document.getElementById('horas').innerText = horas.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('dias').innerText = '0';
                    document.getElementById('horas').innerText = '00';
                }
                
                // Si superamos la fecha de transición, iniciar secuencia
                if (now >= targetTransitionDate && targetTransitionDate !== 0) {
                    initiateWarpTransition();
                }
            }
        }

        function initiateWarpTransition() {
            if (currentState === 'TRANSITION' || currentState === 'ACTIVE') return;
            currentState = 'TRANSITION';
            
            // 1. Mostrar Overlay
            const overlay = document.getElementById('warp-transition-overlay');
            const text = document.getElementById('warp-text');
            const preContainer = document.getElementById('pre-training-container');
            const activeContainer = document.getElementById('portal-active-container');
            
            overlay.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(() => {
                overlay.style.opacity = '1';
                text.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'scale-50');
                text.classList.add('opacity-100', 'scale-100');
            }, 50);

            // 2. Transicionar el DOM de fondo
            setTimeout(() => {
                preContainer.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    preContainer.style.display = 'none';
                    activeContainer.style.display = 'block';
                    // Pequeño delay para que el display block surta efecto antes de opacity
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        activeContainer.style.opacity = '1';
                    }, 50);
                }, 1000);
            }, 1000);

            // 3. Ocultar Overlay y finalizar
            setTimeout(() => {
                text.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'scale-100');
                text.classList.add('opacity-0', 'scale-150');
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    overlay.style.display = 'none';
                    currentState = 'ACTIVE';
                }, 1000);
            }, 4000); // Overlay visible por 4 segundos
        }

        async function fetchAndInitDates() {
            try {
                const now = testTimeOverride ? new Date(testTimeOverride) : new Date();
                const response = await fetch('calendario_c1.json');
                const calendarData = await response.json();
                
                const datesArray = calendarData[sedeCode] || calendarData['LIM'];
                let nextDateStr = null;
                
                const targetEquipo = urlParams.get('equipo');
                
                if (datesArray) {
                    for (const eventObj of datesArray) {
                        const startDateStr = typeof eventObj === 'string' ? eventObj : eventObj.start;
                        if (!startDateStr) continue;
                        
                        // Si nos pasaron un equipo por URL, buscar específicamente ese
                        if (targetEquipo && typeof eventObj !== 'string' && eventObj.equipo !== targetEquipo) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        // REGLA: Ignorar eventos de relleno (entrenador 'nan') si no se pide un equipo específico
                        if (!targetEquipo && typeof eventObj !== 'string' && (eventObj.entrenador === 'nan' || !eventObj.entrenador)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        const dObj = new Date(startDateStr);
                        // El evento permanece activo durante todo el fin de semana del entrenamiento hasta el domingo a las 23:59:59 (aprox 63 horas desde el viernes 09:00 AM)
                        const endStr = eventObj.end;
                        let expirationTime;
                        if (endStr) {
                            const eObj = new Date(endStr);
                            expirationTime = new Date(eObj.getFullYear(), eObj.getMonth(), eObj.getDate(), 23, 59, 59);
                        } else {
                            expirationTime = new Date(dObj.getTime() + (63 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                        }
                        
                        if (expirationTime > now) {
                            nextDateStr = startDateStr;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (nextDateStr) {
                    const startObj = new Date(nextDateStr);
                    const transitionObj = new Date(startObj.getTime() + (3 * 60 * 60 * 1000)); // +3 horas (12:00 PM)
                    const endObj = new Date(startObj.getTime() + (2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)); // +2 días (Domingo)

                    const monthNames = ["enero", "febrero", "marzo", "abril", "mayo", "junio", "julio", "agosto", "septiembre", "octubre", "noviembre", "diciembre"];
                    
                    const startDay = startObj.getDate();
                    const endDay = endObj.getDate();
                    const startMonth = monthNames[startObj.getMonth()];
                    const endMonth = monthNames[endObj.getMonth()];
                    const year = startObj.getFullYear();
                    
                    if (startMonth === endMonth) {
                        currentSede.heroDate = `Del viernes ${startDay} al domingo ${endDay}`;
                        currentSede.heroMonth = `de ${startMonth} de ${year}`;
                    } else {
                        currentSede.heroDate = `Del viernes ${startDay} de ${startMonth} al domingo ${endDay}`;
                        currentSede.heroMonth = `de ${endMonth} de ${year}`;
                    }
                    
                    currentSede.startDateStr = startObj.toISOString();
                    currentSede.transitionDateStr = transitionObj.toISOString();
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Error fetching dates, using fallback:", err);
            }
            
            // Render UI with dynamic or fallback dates
            renderSedeData();
            
            targetStartDate = new Date(currentSede.startDateStr).getTime();
            targetTransitionDate = new Date(currentSede.transitionDateStr).getTime();

            // Timer del sistema
            setInterval(checkSystemState, 1000);
            
            // Ejecución inmediata, pero si hay override y ya pasó, forzamos inicio inmediato
            let nowInitial = testTimeOverride ? new Date(testTimeOverride).getTime() : new Date().getTime();
            if (nowInitial >= targetTransitionDate) {
                document.getElementById('pre-training-container').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('pre-training-container').style.opacity = '0';
                const portal = document.getElementById('portal-active-container');
                portal.style.display = 'block';
                portal.style.opacity = '1';
                currentState = 'ACTIVE';
            } else {
                checkSystemState();
            }
        }

        fetchAndInitDates();

        // ==========================================
        // LÓGICA DE TABS DEL PORTAL ACTIVO Y BITÁCORA
        // ==========================================
        const btnSchedule = document.getElementById('tab-btn-schedule');
        const btnJournal = document.getElementById('tab-btn-journal');
        const contentSchedule = document.getElementById('tab-content-schedule');
        const contentJournal = document.getElementById('tab-content-journal');
        const journalTextArea = document.getElementById('reflection-journal');
        const journalStatus = document.getElementById('journal-status');

        if (btnSchedule && btnJournal) {
            btnSchedule.addEventListener('click', () => {
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('bg-crearDark/50', 'bg-crearCyan');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('text-gray-400', 'text-crearDarker');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('border', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]');
                
                btnJournal.classList.replace('bg-crearCyan', 'bg-crearDark/50');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('text-crearDarker', 'text-gray-400');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]', 'border');

                contentSchedule.classList.remove('hidden');
                contentJournal.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            btnJournal.addEventListener('click', () => {
                btnJournal.classList.replace('bg-crearDark/50', 'bg-crearCyan');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('text-gray-400', 'text-crearDarker');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('border', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]');
                
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('bg-crearCyan', 'bg-crearDark/50');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('text-crearDarker', 'text-gray-400');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]', 'border');

                contentJournal.classList.remove('hidden');
                contentSchedule.classList.add('hidden');
            });
        }

        // Autoguardado de Bitácora
        if (journalTextArea) {
            // Cargar datos previos
            const savedData = localStorage.getItem('cpsl_journal');
            if (savedData) {
                journalTextArea.value = savedData;
            }

            let timeoutId;
            journalTextArea.addEventListener('input', () => {
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                journalStatus.style.opacity = '0';
                
                timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                    localStorage.setItem('cpsl_journal', journalTextArea.value);
                    journalStatus.style.opacity = '1';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        journalStatus.style.opacity = '0';
                    }, 2000);
                }, 1000);
            });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // SISTEMA DE BIENESTAR VISUAL Y GARANTÍA DE LECTURA
        // ==========================================

        // 1. Barra de progreso de lectura basada en el scroll global
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
            const scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - document.documentElement.clientHeight;
            const progress = scrollHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / scrollHeight) * 100 : 0;
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('scroll-progress-bar');
            if (progressBar) {
                progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
            }
        });

        // 2. Controladores de apertura/cierre del panel del Asistente de Lectura
        const assistantTrigger = document.getElementById('assistant-trigger');
        const assistantPanel = document.getElementById('assistant-panel');
        const assistantClose = document.getElementById('assistant-close');

        if (assistantTrigger && assistantPanel && assistantClose) {
            assistantTrigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                assistantPanel.classList.toggle('hidden');
            });

            assistantClose.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                assistantPanel.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            assistantPanel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation(); // Evita que se cierre al hacer click dentro del panel
            });

            document.addEventListener('click', () => {
                assistantPanel.classList.add('hidden');
            });
        }

        // 3. Herramientas Visuales contra el Cansancio
        
        // A. Regla de Enfoque Láser
        const btnRuler = document.getElementById('btn-ruler');
        const rulerEl = document.getElementById('reading-ruler');
        let rulerActive = false;

        if (btnRuler && rulerEl) {
            btnRuler.addEventListener('click', () => {
                rulerActive = !rulerActive;
                if (rulerActive) {
                    rulerEl.style.display = 'block';
                    btnRuler.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnRuler.classList.add('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnRuler.innerText = 'Activo';
                } else {
                    rulerEl.style.display = 'none';
                    btnRuler.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnRuler.classList.remove('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnRuler.innerText = 'Activar';
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                if (rulerActive) {
                    rulerEl.style.transform = `translateY(${e.clientY - 1.5}px)`;
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
                if (rulerActive && e.touches.length > 0) {
                    rulerEl.style.transform = `translateY(${e.touches[0].clientY - 1.5}px)`;
                }
            });
        }

        // B. Modo Concentración por Bloques
        const btnFocus = document.getElementById('btn-focus');
        let focusActive = false;

        if (btnFocus) {
            btnFocus.addEventListener('click', () => {
                focusActive = !focusActive;
                if (focusActive) {
                    document.body.classList.add('block-focus-active');
                    btnFocus.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnFocus.classList.add('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnFocus.innerText = 'Activo';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('block-focus-active');
                    btnFocus.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnFocus.classList.remove('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnFocus.innerText = 'Activar';
                }
            });
        }

        // C. Filtro de Contraste Cálido (Luz de Lectura)
        const btnWarm = document.getElementById('btn-warm');
        let warmActive = false;

        if (btnWarm) {
            btnWarm.addEventListener('click', () => {
                warmActive = !warmActive;
                if (warmActive) {
                    document.body.classList.add('warm-reading-active');
                    btnWarm.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnWarm.classList.add('bg-crearGold', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#ffb703]');
                    btnWarm.innerText = 'Activo';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('warm-reading-active');
                    btnWarm.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnWarm.classList.remove('bg-crearGold', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#ffb703]');
                    btnWarm.innerText = 'Activar';
                }
            });
        }

        // D. Tamaño de Texto Cómodo
        const btnTextSize = document.getElementById('btn-text-size');
        let textLargeActive = false;

        if (btnTextSize) {
            btnTextSize.addEventListener('click', () => {
                textLargeActive = !textLargeActive;
                if (textLargeActive) {
                    document.body.classList.add('large-text-active');
                    btnTextSize.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnTextSize.classList.add('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnTextSize.innerText = 'Grande';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('large-text-active');
                    btnTextSize.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnTextSize.classList.remove('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnTextSize.innerText = 'Normal';
                }
            });
        }

        // 4. Lógica de "Garantía de Lectura Obligatoria" (IntersectionObserver)
        const readingSections = [
            { id: 'grid-info-section', step: 1 },
            { id: 'que-traer-section', step: 2 },
            { id: 'normas-convivencia-section', step: 3 },
            { id: 'compromiso-proceso-section', step: 4 }
        ];

        const readSections = { 1: false, 2: false, 3: false, 4: false };
        const sectionDwellTimes = {};

        function markSectionAsRead(step) {
            if (readSections[step]) return;
            readSections[step] = true;

            const checkEl = document.getElementById(`check-step-${step}`);
            const statusEl = document.getElementById(`status-step-${step}`);

            if (checkEl) {
                checkEl.classList.remove('border-gray-600', 'text-gray-500');
                checkEl.classList.add('bg-green-500/20', 'border-green-500', 'text-green-400');
                checkEl.innerText = '✓';
            }

            if (statusEl) {
                statusEl.classList.remove('text-gray-500');
                statusEl.classList.add('text-green-400', 'font-bold');
                statusEl.innerText = 'Leído';
            }

            updateReadingCompletion();
        }

        function updateReadingCompletion() {
            const completedCount = Object.values(readSections).filter(Boolean).length;
            const percentage = Math.round((completedCount / 4) * 100);

            const badgeEl = document.getElementById('assistant-badge');
            const progressTextEl = document.getElementById('panel-progress-text');

            if (badgeEl) {
                badgeEl.innerText = `${percentage}%`;
                if (percentage === 100) {
                    badgeEl.classList.remove('bg-crearRed', 'animate-bounce');
                    badgeEl.classList.add('bg-green-500');
                    badgeEl.innerText = '✓';
                }
            }

            if (progressTextEl) {
                progressTextEl.innerText = `${percentage}%`;
                if (percentage === 100) {
                    progressTextEl.classList.remove('text-crearCyan');
                    progressTextEl.classList.add('text-green-400');
                }
            }

            if (percentage === 100) {
                unlockConfirmation();
            }
        }

        function unlockConfirmation() {
            // Revelar el banner de felicitación en la sección de contacto
            const bannerEl = document.getElementById('completion-banner');
            if (bannerEl) {
                bannerEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                bannerEl.classList.add('block');
            }

            // Aplicar brillo y animación de resplandor cuántico a los botones de confirmación
            const waButtons = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="wa.me"]');
            waButtons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.add('completion-glow');
            });

            const heroBtn = document.querySelector('a[href="#contacto"]');
            if (heroBtn) {
                heroBtn.classList.add('completion-glow');
                heroBtn.innerHTML = '✨ ¡LECTURA COMPLETADA! CONFIRMAR ASISTENCIA';
            }
        }

        const observerOptions = {
            root: null,
            rootMargin: '0px',
            threshold: 0.15 // Al menos el 15% de la sección debe estar en pantalla
        };

        const readingObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                const sectionId = entry.target.id;
                const sectionConfig = readingSections.find(s => s.id === sectionId);
                if (!sectionConfig) return;

                const step = sectionConfig.step;

                if (entry.isIntersecting && !readSections[step]) {
                    // Si el usuario permanece 1.8 segundos en la sección, se marca como leída
                    sectionDwellTimes[step] = setTimeout(() => {
                        markSectionAsRead(step);
                    }, 1800);
                } else {
                    // Si sale de la pantalla antes de cumplirse el tiempo, cancelamos el temporizador
                    if (sectionDwellTimes[step]) {
                        clearTimeout(sectionDwellTimes[step]);
                        delete sectionDwellTimes[step];
                    }
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observar cada sección crítica
        readingSections.forEach(sec => {
            const el = document.getElementById(sec.id);
            if (el) readingObserver.observe(el);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        let assignmentProjection = [];

        .cropper-modal-overlay img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 60vh; }
        .cropper-container { max-height: 60vh !important; }

        /* Sidebar Menú Lateral styles */
        #sidebar {
            width: 260px;
            transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }
        #topHeader {
            transition: left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }
        #mainContent {
            transition: padding-left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }
        /* Mobile default is closed. On .sidebar-open body class: open slide */
        .sidebar-open #sidebar {
            transform: translateX(0);
        }
        /* Desktop: shift main content and fixed top-bar when sidebar is open */
        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
            .sidebar-open #mainContent {
                padding-left: 260px !important;
            }
            .sidebar-open #topHeader {
                left: 260px !important;
                width: calc(100% - 260px) !important;
            }
        }
        #sidebarBackdrop {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease, backdrop-filter 0.3s ease;
        }
        .sidebar-open #sidebarBackdrop {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-crearDarker antialiased hero-gradient min-h-screen sidebar-open">

    <script>
        /**
         * [SEGURIDAD - CAPA GRATUITA]
         * Los datos sensibles de los entrenadores (pasaportes, seguros) están encriptados
         * en el DOM usando XOR simétrico (llave derived de contraseña). No se desencriptan
         * ni se cargan en memoria hasta una autenticación exitosa.
         * Limitación conocida: Ofuscación del lado del cliente, apta para entornos demo/privados.
         */
        function xorDecrypt(base64Str, keyStr) {
            try {
                const encStr = atob(base64Str);
                let decBytes = new Uint8Array(encStr.length);
                for (let i = 0; i < encStr.length; i++) {
                    decBytes[i] = encStr.charCodeAt(i) ^ keyStr.charCodeAt(i % keyStr.length);
                }
                if (window.TextDecoder) {
                    return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(decBytes);
                } else {
                    let out = "";
                    for (let i = 0; i < decBytes.length; i++) {
                        out += String.fromCharCode(decBytes[i]);
                    }
                    return decodeURIComponent(escape(out));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Decryption error:", e);
                return null;
            }
        }
```
