```html
                // Silently request server-side backup if not running locally or on static github page
                if (window.location.protocol !== 'file:' && !window.location.hostname.includes('github.io')) {
                    fetch('/api/export-backup').catch(() => {});
                }
            } catch (e) {
                showToast("❌ Error al exportar respaldo", "error");
            }
        }

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // GOOGLE SHEETS - SINCRONIZACIÓN DE ENTRENADORES
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        async function fetchGoogleSheetsTrainers() {
          // Se conserva el nombre que llega desde la agenda como
          // `sheetTrainer` para contraste histórico. Este calendario ya no
          // acepta que Sheets sobrescriba un entrenador confirmado: esa
          // decisión solo se toma y se persiste en el Asignador de Causa OS.
          console.info('Sheets permanece como contraste; el Asignador de Causa OS es la fuente de asignaciones.');
          return false;
        }

        // La actualización periódica consulta el Asignador dentro de
        // syncFromServer(); no se ejecuta ninguna escritura/override desde
        // Sheets en segundo plano.

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // GOOGLE DRIVE - ESCANEO AUTOMÁTICO DE TIQUETES
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        const DRIVE_FOLDER_ID = '1opVrJrmZBuiSYSlVvTwAXb2Q1_SydvT7';
        const DRIVE_API_KEY = 'TU_API_KEY_DE_GOOGLE_CLOUD'; // Necesitas crear una API key en Google Cloud Console

        async function scanDriveForTickets() {
          try {
            if (DRIVE_API_KEY === 'TU_API_KEY_DE_GOOGLE_CLOUD') {
              console.log('ℹ️ Para activar escaneo automático de Drive, configura DRIVE_API_KEY.');
              return;
            }
            const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q='${DRIVE_FOLDER_ID}'+in+parents+and+trashed=false&fields=files(id,name,mimeType,createdTime,webContentLink)&key=${DRIVE_API_KEY}&orderBy=createdTime+desc`;
            
            const res = await fetch(url);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error al consultar Drive');
            
            const data = await res.json();
            const files = data.files || [];
            
            console.log(`📁 Encontrados ${files.length} archivos en Drive`);
            
            // Procesar cada archivo
            for (const file of files) {
              await processDriveFile(file);
            }
            
            showToast(`✅ ${files.length} tiquetes procesados desde Drive`);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error escaneando Drive:', err);
          }
        }

        async function processDriveFile(file) {
          // Verificar si ya fue procesado (guardar en localStorage)
          const processedFiles = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('processedDriveFiles') || '[]');
          if (processedFiles.includes(file.id)) {
            console.log(`⏭️ Archivo ya procesado: ${file.name}`);
            return;
          }
          
          console.log(`🔄 Procesando: ${file.name}`);
          
          // Si es PDF o imagen, intentar OCR
          if (file.mimeType.includes('pdf') || file.mimeType.includes('image')) {
            try {
              // Descargar archivo
              const fileRes = await fetch(file.webContentLink);
              const blob = await fileRes.blob();
              
              // Crear objeto File para Tesseract
              const fileObj = new File([blob], file.name, { type: file.mimeType });
              
              // Ejecutar OCR
              const worker = await Tesseract.createWorker('spa+eng');
              const { data: { text } } = await worker.recognize(fileObj);
              await worker.terminate();
              
              // Extraer datos del tiquete
              const flightData = extraerDatosTiquete(text);
              
              if (flightData.numero_vuelo) {
                console.log(`✅ Datos extraídos:`, flightData);
                
                // Buscar evento correspondiente y actualizar
                actualizarEventoConDatosVuelo(flightData, file.name);
              }
              
              // Marcar como procesado
              processedFiles.push(file.id);
              localStorage.setItem('processedDriveFiles', JSON.stringify(processedFiles));
              
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error procesando ${file.name}:`, err);
            }
          }
        }

        function actualizarEventoConDatosVuelo(flightData, fileName) {
          // Buscar evento por nombre de archivo o fecha
          Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sede => {
            allEventsData[sede].forEach(ev => {
              const log = ev.logistics || {};
              
              // Si el archivo contiene el nombre del entrenador o la fecha del evento
              const trainerMatch = ev.trainer && fileName.toUpperCase().includes(ev.trainer.toUpperCase().split(' ')[0]);
              const dateMatch = new Date(ev.start).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === fileName.match(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)?.[0];
              
              if (trainerMatch || dateMatch) {
                if (!ev.logistics) ev.logistics = {};
                
                // Actualizar solo si no hay datos previos
                if (!log.aerolinea && flightData.aerolinea) ev.logistics.aerolinea = flightData.aerolinea;
                if (!log.numero_vuelo && flightData.numero_vuelo) ev.logistics.numero_vuelo = flightData.numero_vuelo;
                if (!log.origen && flightData.origen) ev.logistics.origen = flightData.origen;
                if (!log.destino && flightData.destino) ev.logistics.destino = flightData.destino;
                if (!log.pnr && flightData.pnr) ev.logistics.pnr = flightData.pnr;
                
                console.log(`✅ Evento actualizado: ${ev.name} - Equipo ${ev.equipo}`);
              }
            });
          });
          
          // Re-renderizar
          renderEvents();
          if (typeof renderVuelosActivosDashboard === 'function') {
            renderVuelosActivosDashboard();
          }
        }

        // Escanear Drive cada 5 minutos
        setInterval(scanDriveForTickets, 5 * 60 * 1000);

        // Escanear al cargar
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
          setTimeout(scanDriveForTickets, 3000);
        });

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // DIRECTORIO CREAR PODER SIN LÍMITES - MAPEO AUTOMÁTICO
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        const DIRECTORIO_SHEET_1 = '1u0tc4GeooPmSwNxZ0CErKGtRU4oD-mO3l--ZSQM-KPs';
        const DIRECTORIO_SHEET_2 = '1PCwGSYxjNm_ieSHtD2BY6vkDPakFyt8Ctq7rlcmX65k';

        async function fetchDirectorioCREAR() {
          try {
            // Sheet 1 - Directorio principal / DB
            const url1 = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${DIRECTORIO_SHEET_1}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&gid=1326951636`;
            const res1 = await fetch(url1);
            const text1 = await res1.text();
            const json1 = JSON.parse(text1.substring(47, text1.length - 2));
            
            console.log('📋 Base de datos de logística cargada:', json1.table.rows.length, 'registros');
            
            // Sheet 2 - Directorio principal de personas
            const url2 = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${DIRECTORIO_SHEET_2}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json`;
            const res2 = await fetch(url2);
            const text2 = await res2.text();
            const json2 = JSON.parse(text2.substring(47, text2.length - 2));
            
            console.log('📋 Directorio CREAR personas cargado:', json2.table.rows.length, 'registros');
            
            // Procesar directorio de personas (desde DIRECTORIO_SHEET_2 = 1PCwGSYxjNm con mapeo correcto de columnas)
            const directorio = json2.table.rows.map(row => ({
              nombre: row.c[0]?.v || '',
              rol: row.c[1]?.v || '',
              email: row.c[2]?.v || '',
              sede: row.c[3]?.v || '',
              telefono: row.c[4]?.v || ''
            }));
            
            // Guardar en localStorage para uso offline
            localStorage.setItem('directorioCREAR', JSON.stringify(directorio));
            
            showToast('✅ Directorio CREAR sincronizado');
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error cargando directorio CREAR:", err);
          }
        }

        // Cargar directorio al inicio
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
          setTimeout(fetchDirectorioCREAR, 2000);
        });

        // Actualizar cada 30 minutos
        setInterval(fetchDirectorioCREAR, 30 * 60 * 1000);

        renderSedeTabs();
        renderEvents();
        startSync(); // ← Inicia sync multi-gerente cada 30s
        fetchGoogleSheetsTrainers();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<body class="font-sans antialiased relative min-h-screen">

    <!-- FONDOS ANIMADOS -->
    <div class="fixed inset-0 z-[-1] overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div class="absolute top-[-10%] left-[-10%] w-[40%] h-[40%] bg-crearBlue/20 rounded-full blur-[120px] animate-float"></div>
        <div class="absolute bottom-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[40%] h-[40%] bg-crearCyan/20 rounded-full blur-[120px] animate-float-delayed"></div>
        <div class="absolute top-[40%] left-[50%] w-[30%] h-[30%] bg-crearGold/10 rounded-full blur-[100px] animate-pulse-slow"></div>
        
        <!-- Contenedor de partículas generadas por JS -->
        <div id="particles-container" class="absolute inset-0 opacity-40"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- NAVBAR SIMPLIFICADO -->
    <nav class="fixed top-0 w-full z-50 glassmorphism border-b-0 py-3">
        <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex justify-between items-center">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <img src="logo_crear_blanco.png" alt="CREAR Poder Sin Límites" class="h-8 md:h-10 object-contain">
            </div>
            <div class="hidden md:flex text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-gray-400 uppercase">
                <span>Ecuador <span class="text-crearCyan mx-2">•</span> Perú <span class="text-crearCyan mx-2">•</span> Colombia <span class="text-crearCyan mx-2">•</span> México</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Barra de Progreso de Lectura Activa -->
        <div id="scroll-progress-container">
            <div id="scroll-progress-bar"></div>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- MAIN CONTENT -->
    <main class="pt-28 pb-20 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto relative overflow-hidden">
        
        <!-- PRE-TRAINING CONTAINER (Default visible) -->
        <div id="pre-training-container" class="transition-all duration-1000">
            <!-- HEADER / HERO -->
            <header class="text-center mb-16 animate-slide-up">
                <div id="sede-location-badge" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]">
                    <img id="sede-flag" src="" alt="Flag" class="w-5 h-auto rounded-[2px] hidden shadow-sm border border-white/20" />
                    <span id="sede-city-name" class="text-white text-sm font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">LIMA, PERÚ</span>
                </div>
                <br>
                <span class="inline-block py-1 px-3 rounded-full bg-crearCyan/10 border border-crearCyan/30 text-crearCyan text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase mb-4 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.2)]">
                    Bienvenida Oficial al Capítulo Dos
                </span>
                <h1 class="text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black font-outfit tracking-tight mb-4 leading-tight">
                    <span class="text-gradient">Tu Transformación Cuántica</span><br>en Capítulo Dos Comienza YA
                </h1>
                <h2 class="text-lg md:text-xl font-light text-gray-300 mb-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
                    ¡Felicidades, Creador Cuántico del <span id="team-badge" class="text-crearCyan font-bold">Equipo ...</span>! Estás a punto de ingresar al espacio vivencial donde romperás paradigmas, potenciarás tu ser y diseñarás un futuro extraordinario.
                </h2>
                
                <div class="mb-8 relative z-10">
                    <a href="#contacto" class="inline-block bg-crearCyan hover:bg-crearBlue transition-colors text-crearDarker font-bold py-3 px-8 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,210,255,0.6)] transform hover:-translate-y-1 cursor-pointer uppercase tracking-wider text-sm">
                        CONFIRMAR MI ASISTENCIA AL CAPÍTULO DOS
                    </a>
                </div>

                <!-- FECHAS DESTACADAS PREMIUM -->
                <div class="mb-10 relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center animate-pulse-slow">
                    <p class="text-xs text-crearCyan font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] mb-3">Reserva estas fechas</p>
                    <div class="border-y border-crearGold/30 py-4 px-8 bg-crearGold/5 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-sm shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,183,3,0.15)]">
                        <p id="hero-date-main" class="text-crearGold font-black text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl uppercase tracking-tight drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,183,3,0.6)]">Del jueves 01 al domingo 04</p>
                        <p id="hero-month-main" class="text-crearGold font-bold text-xl md:text-2xl mt-1 tracking-widest">de octubre de 2026</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- CONTADOR REGRESIVO -->
                <div class="mb-10 text-center relative z-10">
                    <p class="text-crearGold text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase mb-2">Falta poco para comenzar tu C2</p>
                    <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-crearDark/50 border border-crearGold/30 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,183,3,0.1)]">
                        <div class="text-center">
                            <span id="dias" class="text-4xl font-black text-white font-mono">...</span>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Días</p>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-3xl text-crearGold/50 pb-4">:</span>
                        <div class="text-center">
                            <span id="horas" class="text-4xl font-black text-white font-mono">..</span>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Horas</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm mt-3">para dar tu siguiente salto de consciencia</p>
                </div>
                
                <div class="text-base md:text-lg text-gray-400 font-light leading-relaxed max-w-4xl mx-auto glass-card p-6 md:p-8 rounded-2xl text-left sm:text-center relative z-10">
                    <p class="text-white font-medium mb-4"><strong class="font-bold text-crearCyan">En CREAR no venimos a motivarte. La motivación es temporal. Venimos a entrenarte para que desarrolles nuevas formas de pensar, actuar y sostener resultados extraordinarios.</strong></p>
                    <p class="mb-4">El Capítulo Dos es el espacio de consolidación vivencial donde tus intenciones se convierten en carácter y tu visión se alinea con tu poder personal sin límites.</p>
                    <p class="text-crearGold font-medium">Nos comprometemos a entregarte un entorno seguro, impecable y de altísima vibración. Tu compromiso es presentarte con total puntualidad y entrega.</p>
                </div>

                <!-- REPRODUCTOR DE AUDIO DE FONDO -->
                <audio id="bg-audio" loop>
                    <source src="vivo_pedro_capo.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
                </audio>

                <script>
                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                        var audio = document.getElementById('bg-audio');
                        if (audio) {
                            audio.volume = 0.35;
                            var audioStarted = false;
                            var startAudio = function() {
                                if (audioStarted) return;
                                if (audio.currentTime < 15) audio.currentTime = 15;
                                audio.play().then(function() {
                                    audioStarted = true;
                                    document.body.removeEventListener('click', startAudio);
                                    document.body.removeEventListener('touchstart', startAudio);
                                }).catch(function(e) {});
                            };
                            document.body.addEventListener('click', startAudio);
                            document.body.addEventListener('touchstart', startAudio);
                        }
                    });
                </script>
            </header>

            <!-- GRID DE INFORMACIÓN (2 COLUMNAS) -->
            <div id="grid-info-section" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-12">
                
                <!-- TARJETA: INFORMACIÓN CLAVE -->
                <div class="glass-card rounded-3xl p-8 reveal">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-crearCyan/20 flex items-center justify-center text-crearCyan">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-6 h-6">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 10.5a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19.5 10.5c0 7.142-7.5 11.25-7.5 11.25S4.5 17.642 4.5 10.5a7.5 7.5 0 1115 0z" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="text-2xl font-black font-outfit text-white">Información Clave</h3>
                    </div>
                    
                    <ul class="space-y-5">
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-4">
                            <div class="mt-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-crearCyan shadow-[0_0_8px_#00d2ff]"></div>
                            <div>
                                <p class="text-xs text-crearCyan font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Lugar de Entrenamiento</p>
                                <p id="hotel-name" class="text-white font-medium text-lg leading-snug">Hotel José Antonio Deluxe</p>
                                <p id="hotel-address" class="text-gray-400 text-sm">Calle Bellavista 133 – Miraflores 15038</p>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-start gap-4">
                            <div class="mt-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-crearCyan shadow-[0_0_8px_#00d2ff]"></div>
                            <div>
                                <p class="text-xs text-crearCyan font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Fechas Oficiales</p>
                                <p id="hero-date" class="text-crearGold font-black text-2xl md:text-3xl uppercase tracking-tight drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,183,3,0.4)]">Del jueves 01 al domingo 04</p>
                                <p id="hero-month" class="text-crearGold font-bold text-lg mt-1 tracking-widest">de octubre de 2026</p>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <!-- TARJETA: HORARIOS (4 DÍAS DE CAPÍTULO DOS) -->
                <div class="glass-card rounded-3xl p-8 reveal">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-crearGold/20 flex items-center justify-center text-crearGold">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-6 h-6">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 6v6h4.5m4.5 0a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="text-2xl font-black font-outfit text-white">Horarios Oficiales</h3>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="space-y-4">
                        <div class="bg-crearDark/50 border border-crearBorder/30 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <span class="text-2xl font-black text-white font-outfit">JUE</span>
                                <span class="bg-crearCyan/20 text-crearCyan text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase tracking-wide">¡Registro y Apertura!</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-right sm:text-left">
                                <p class="text-white font-mono font-medium">13:00 hrs Mesa de Registro</p>
                                <p class="text-gray-400 text-xs">Apertura: 14:00 hrs - Fin: 22:30 hrs (aprox.)</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="bg-crearDark/50 border border-crearBorder/30 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-300 font-outfit">VIE Y SÁB</span>
                            <div class="text-right">
                                <p class="text-white font-mono font-medium">09:00 hrs - 22:30 hrs / 23:00 hrs</p>
                                <p class="text-gray-400 text-xs">(permanencia completa requerida)</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="bg-crearDark/50 border border-crearBorder/30 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-300 font-outfit">DOM</span>
                            <div class="text-right">
                                <p class="text-white font-mono font-medium">08:00 hrs - 20:00 hrs</p>
                                <p class="text-gray-400 text-xs">(aprox. Clausura del Capítulo)</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- MAPA INTERACTIVO DE GOOGLE MAPS -->
            <div class="glass-card rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 mb-12 reveal overflow-hidden relative border border-crearBorder/20">
                <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6 items-center">
                    <div class="w-full md:w-1/3 space-y-4">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-crearCyan/20 flex items-center justify-center text-crearCyan">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 10.5a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19.5 10.5c0 7.142-7.5 11.25-7.5 11.25S4.5 17.642 4.5 10.5a7.5 7.5 0 1115 0z" />
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                            <h4 class="text-xl font-black font-outfit text-white">¿Cómo llegar?</h4>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <p id="hotel-name-map" class="text-white font-bold text-lg">Hotel José Antonio Deluxe</p>
                            <p id="hotel-address-map" class="text-gray-400 text-sm mt-1">Calle Bellavista 133, Miraflores 15038</p>
                            <p id="hotel-city-map" class="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">Lima, Perú</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="pt-2">
                            <a id="map-link" href="https://maps.google.com/?q=Hotel+José+Antonio+Deluxe+Miraflores+Calle+Bellavista+133" target="_blank" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-crearCyan/10 hover:bg-crearCyan/20 border border-crearCyan/30 text-crearCyan font-bold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer">
                                <span>Abrir en Google Maps</span>
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-3.5 h-3.5">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13.5 6H5.25A2.25 2.25 0 003 8.25v10.5A2.25 2.25 0 005.25 21h10.5A2.25 2.25 0 0018 18.75V10.5m-10.5 6L21 3m0 0h-5.25M21 3v5.25" />
                                </svg>
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="w-full md:w-2/3 h-64 md:h-80 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-crearBorder/30 shadow-inner relative">
                        <iframe 
                            id="map-iframe"
                            src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m18!1m12!1m3!1d3900.7430415!2d-77.0313019!3d-12.1290333!2m3!1f0!2f0!3f0!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x9105c819389bd7c9%3A0xbd7c8ee17dfbc462!2sHotel%20Jos%C3%A9%20Antonio%20Deluxe!5e0!3m2!1ses!2spe!4v1719528000000!5m2!1ses!2spe" 
                            class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full border-0" 
                            allowfullscreen="" 
                            loading="lazy" 
                            referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade">
                        </iframe>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- SECCIÓN: QUÉ TRAER Y PREPARACIÓN ESENCIAL -->
            <div id="que-traer-section" class="glass-card rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-10 mb-12 border-t-4 border-t-crearCyan reveal relative overflow-hidden">
                <div class="absolute -right-20 -top-20 opacity-5">
                    <svg class="w-64 h-64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 22C6.477 22 2 17.523 2 12S6.477 2 12 2s10 4.477 10 10-4.477 10-10 10zm0-2a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm-1-5h2v2h-2v-2zm2-1.645V14h-2v-1.5a1 1 0 011-1 1.5 1.5 0 10-1.471-1.304L6.5 10A3.5 3.5 0 1113 13.355z"/></svg>
                </div>
                
                <h3 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black font-outfit text-white mb-8 text-center">Herramientas y Preparación Esencial de Capítulo Dos</h3>
                
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                    <!-- Ítem 1: Documento de Identidad -->
                    <div class="bg-crearDark/60 p-6 rounded-2xl text-center border border-crearBorder/30 hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-colors group">
                        <div class="w-14 h-14 mx-auto bg-crearCyan/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-7 h-7 text-crearCyan">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 9h3.75M15 12h3.75M15 15h3.75M4.5 19.5h15a2.25 2.25 0 002.25-2.25V6.75A2.25 2.25 0 0019.5 4.5h-15a2.25 2.25 0 00-2.25 2.25v10.5A2.25 2.25 0 004.5 19.5zm6-10.125a1.875 1.875 0 11-3.75 0 1.875 1.875 0 013.75 0zm1.294 6.336a6.721 6.721 0 01-3.17.789 6.721 6.721 0 01-3.168-.789 3.376 3.376 0 016.338 0z" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-lg mb-2">Documento de Identidad</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">Indispensable traer tu DNI físico, Pasaporte o documento de identidad oficial para tu acreditación el jueves a las 13:00 hrs.</p>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Ítem 2: Lectura Indispensable -->
                    <div class="bg-crearDark/60 p-6 rounded-2xl text-center border border-crearBorder/30 hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-colors group">
                        <div class="w-14 h-14 mx-auto bg-crearCyan/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-7 h-7 text-crearCyan">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 6.042A8.967 8.967 0 006 3.75c-1.052 0-2.062.18-2.98.512v14.125A8.94 8.967 0 016 18c2.305 0 4.408.867 6 2.292m0-14.25a8.966 8.967 0 016-2.292c1.052 0 2.062.18 2.98.512v14.125A8.94 8.97 0 0018 18c-2.305 0-4.408.867-6 2.292m0-14.25v14.25" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-lg mb-2">Lectura Indispensable</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">Debes haber leído <strong class="text-crearGold">"Los Cuatro Acuerdos"</strong> de Don Miguel Ruiz. Es la base fundamental para el despegue de tu C2.</p>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Ítem 3: Kit de Herramientas C2 -->
                    <div class="bg-crearDark/60 p-6 rounded-2xl text-center border border-crearBorder/30 hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-colors group">
                        <div class="w-14 h-14 mx-auto bg-crearCyan/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-7 h-7 text-crearCyan">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M11.42 15.17L17.25 21A2.67 2.67 0 1021 17.25l-5.83-5.83m-3.75 3.75a3.75 3.75 0 11-5.3-5.3 3.75 3.75 0 015.3 5.3zm6-10.5a2.25 2.25 0 11-4.5 0 2.25 2.25 0 014.5 0z" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-lg mb-2">Kit de Herramientas C2</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">Indispensable traer: <strong class="text-white">Cuaderno A4 cuadriculado, lapicero, una sábana (sin elástico) y tu Ticket Rojo</strong>.</p>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Ítem 4: Comodidad y Abrigo -->
                    <div class="bg-crearDark/60 p-6 rounded-2xl text-center border border-crearBorder/30 hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-colors group">
                        <div class="w-14 h-14 mx-auto bg-crearCyan/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-7 h-7 text-crearCyan">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9.53 16.122a3 3 0 00-5.965 1.49M9.53 16.122a3 3 0 015.965-1.49M9.53 16.122a3 3 0 01-5.965 1.49m5.965-1.49a3 3 0 005.965 1.49m-5.965-1.49a3 3 0 00-5.965-1.49" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-lg mb-2">Ropa Cómoda y Abrigo</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">Ropa muy cómoda para moverte. <span id="abrigo-text" class="text-crearGold font-medium">El aire acondicionado del salón suele estar frío;</span> es obligatorio traer abrigo (chompa, casaca) y snacks.</p>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Ítem 5: Hidratación -->
                    <div class="bg-crearDark/60 p-6 rounded-2xl text-center border border-crearBorder/30 hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-colors group">
                        <div class="w-14 h-14 mx-auto bg-crearCyan/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-7 h-7 text-crearCyan">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9.75 3.104v5.714a2.25 2.25 0 01-.659 1.591L5 14.5M9.75 3.104c-.251.023-.501.05-.75.082m.75-.082a24.301 24.301 0 014.5 0m0 0v5.714c0 .597.237 1.17.659 1.591L19.8 15.3M14.25 3.104c.251.023.501.05.75.082M19.8 15.3l-1.57.393A9.065 9.065 0 0112 15a9.065 9.065 0 00-6.23-.693L5 14.5m14.8.8l1.402 1.402c1.232 1.232.65 3.318-1.067 3.611A48.309 48.309 0 0112 21c-2.773 0-5.491-.235-8.135-.687-1.718-.293-2.3-2.379-1.067-3.61L5 14.5" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-lg mb-2">Botella con Agua</h4>

    <!-- INTERACTIVIDAD JS Y MOTOR MULTI-SEDE DE CAPÍTULO DOS -->
    <script>
        // 1. Generador de Partículas de fondo
        const particlesContainer = document.getElementById('particles-container');
        for(let i=0; i<40; i++) {
            const particle = document.createElement('div');
            particle.className = 'particle';
            
            const x = Math.random() * 100;
            const y = Math.random() * 100;
            const size = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
            const duration = Math.random() * 10 + 10;
            const delay = Math.random() * 5;
            
            particle.style.left = `${x}%`;
            particle.style.top = `${y}%`;
            particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
            particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
            
            const colors = ['rgba(255,255,255,0.3)', 'rgba(0,210,255,0.4)', 'rgba(255,183,3,0.3)'];
            particle.style.background = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
            
            particle.animate([
                { transform: 'translate(0,0) scale(1)', opacity: Math.random() * 0.3 },
                { transform: `translate(${(Math.random()-0.5)*150}px, ${(Math.random()-0.5)*150}px) scale(${Math.random()*1.5})`, opacity: Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.2 },
                { transform: 'translate(0,0) scale(1)', opacity: Math.random() * 0.3 }
            ], {
                duration: duration * 1000,
                iterations: Infinity,
                delay: delay * 1000,
                direction: 'alternate',
                easing: 'ease-in-out'
            });
            
            particlesContainer.appendChild(particle);
        }

        // 2. Animación de entrada al hacer scroll (Reveal elements)
        function reveal() {
            const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
            for (let i = 0; i < reveals.length; i++) {
                const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
                const elementTop = reveals[i].getBoundingClientRect().top;
                const elementVisible = 100;
                
                if (elementTop < windowHeight - elementVisible) {
                    reveals[i].classList.add('active');
                }
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener('scroll', reveal);
        setTimeout(reveal, 100);

        // ==========================================
        // DICCIONARIO DE CONFIGURACIÓN MULTI-SEDE (C2)
        // ==========================================
        const sedeConfig = {
            "LIM": {
                name: "Lima, Perú",
                countryCode: "pe",
                hotelName: "Hotel José Antonio Deluxe",

        // Extraer parámetros URL
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const sedeCode = (urlParams.get('sede') || 'LIM').toUpperCase();
        const testTimeOverride = urlParams.get('test_time'); // ej: 2026-08-27T14:00:00
        
        const currentSede = sedeConfig[sedeCode] || sedeConfig['LIM'];

        // ==========================================
        // RENDERIZAR DATOS DE LA SEDE EN EL DOM
        // ==========================================
        function renderSedeData() {
            // Actualizar Badge de Ciudad y Bandera
            const sedeFlag = document.getElementById('sede-flag');
            const sedeCityName = document.getElementById('sede-city-name');
            if (sedeFlag && sedeCityName && currentSede.countryCode) {
                sedeFlag.src = `https://flagcdn.com/${currentSede.countryCode}.svg`;
                sedeFlag.classList.remove('hidden');
                sedeCityName.innerText = currentSede.name;
            }

            document.getElementById('team-badge').innerText = currentSede.team || 'Equipo Activo';
            document.getElementById('hotel-name').innerText = currentSede.hotelName;
            document.getElementById('hotel-address').innerText = currentSede.hotelAddress;
            document.getElementById('hero-date').innerText = currentSede.heroDate;
            document.getElementById('hero-month').innerText = currentSede.heroMonth;
            
            const heroDateMainEl = document.getElementById('hero-date-main');
            if (heroDateMainEl) heroDateMainEl.innerText = currentSede.heroDate;
            
            const heroMonthMainEl = document.getElementById('hero-month-main');
            if (heroMonthMainEl) heroMonthMainEl.innerText = currentSede.heroMonth;
            
            document.getElementById('hotel-name-map').innerText = currentSede.hotelName;
            document.getElementById('hotel-address-map').innerText = currentSede.hotelAddress;
            document.getElementById('hotel-city-map').innerText = currentSede.name;
            
            document.getElementById('map-iframe').src = currentSede.mapSrc;
            document.getElementById('map-link').href = currentSede.mapLink;
            
            const abrigoText = document.getElementById('abrigo-text');
            if (abrigoText) {
                if (currentSede.coldAC) {
                    abrigoText.innerText = `El aire acondicionado de ${currentSede.hotelName} suele estar frío;`;
                } else {
                    abrigoText.innerText = `Es posible que la temperatura varíe en el salón;`;
                }
            }
            
            // Generar botones de coordinadores para WhatsApp
            const coordContainer = document.getElementById('coordinators-container');
            if (coordContainer) {
                coordContainer.innerHTML = '';
                currentSede.coordinators.forEach(coord => {
                    const waText = encodeURIComponent(`Hola ${coord.name}, quiero confirmar mi asistencia al entrenamiento CREAR Capítulo Dos del ${currentSede.team || ''}`);
                    const waLink = `https://wa.me/${coord.phone}?text=${waText}`;
                    coordContainer.innerHTML += `
                    <a href="${waLink}" target="_blank" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-[#25D366]/10 hover:bg-[#25D366]/20 border border-[#25D366]/30 text-white px-6 py-4 rounded-xl transition-all group shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,211,102,0.15)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(37,211,102,0.3)] cursor-pointer">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-6 h-6 text-[#25D366] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M.057 24l1.687-6.163c-1.041-1.804-1.588-3.849-1.587-5.946.003-6.556 5.338-11.891 11.893-11.891 3.181.001 6.167 1.24 8.413 3.488 2.245 2.248 3.481 5.236 3.48 8.414-.003 6.557-5.338 11.892-11.893 11.892-1.99-.001-3.951-.5-5.688-1.448l-6.305 1.654zm6.597-3.807c1.676.995 3.276 1.591 5.392 1.592 5.448 0 9.886-4.434 9.889-9.885.002-5.462-4.415-9.89-9.881-9.892-5.452 0-9.887 4.434-9.889 9.884-.001 2.225.651 3.891 1.746 5.634l-.999 3.648 3.742-.981zm11.387-5.464c-.074-.124-.272-.198-.57-.347-.297-.149-1.758-.87-2.031-.97-.272-.099-.47-.149-.669.149-.198.297-.768.97-.941 1.168-.173.198-.347.223-.644.074-.297-.149-1.255-.462-2.39-1.305-.88-.653-1.473-1.46-1.646-1.758-.173-.297-.018-.458.13-.606.134-.133.297-.347.446-.52.151-.172.2-.296.3-.495.099-.198.05-.372-.025-.52-.075-.149-.669-1.611-.916-2.206-.242-.579-.487-.501-.669-.51l-.57-.01c-.198 0-.52.074-.792.347-.272.297-1.04 1.016-1.04 2.479 0 1.463 1.065 2.876 1.213 3.074.149.198 2.096 3.2 5.077 4.487.709.306 1.263.489 1.694.626.712.226 1.36.194 1.872.118.571-.085 1.758-.719 2.006-1.413.248-.695.248-1.29.173-1.414z"/></svg>
                        <div class="text-left">
                            <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[#25D366] font-bold">${coord.role || 'Coordinadora'}</p>
                            <p class="font-medium font-outfit">${coord.name}</p>
                        </div>
                    </a>`;
                });
            }

            // Generar botones en modal de Maestría
            const modalCoordContainer = document.getElementById('maestria-coordinators-container');
            if (modalCoordContainer) {
                modalCoordContainer.innerHTML = '';
                currentSede.coordinators.forEach(coord => {
                    const joyceMsg = encodeURIComponent(`Hola ${coord.name}, quiero reservar mi cupo para el entrenamiento Maestría del Juego del ${currentSede.team || ''}`);
                    modalCoordContainer.innerHTML += `
                    <a href="https://wa.me/${coord.phone}?text=${joyceMsg}" target="_blank" class="flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-crearGold/10 to-yellow-500/5 hover:from-crearGold/20 hover:to-yellow-500/10 border border-crearGold/30 text-white px-6 py-4 rounded-xl transition-all group shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,183,3,0.05)] cursor-pointer">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-crearGold/20 flex items-center justify-center text-crearGold font-bold font-outfit">${coord.name.charAt(0)}</div>
                            <div class="text-left">
                                <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-crearGold font-bold">${coord.role || 'Coordinadora'}</p>
                                <p class="font-bold text-sm font-outfit">${coord.name}</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-6 h-6 text-[#25D366] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M.057 24l1.687-6.163c-1.041-1.804-1.588-3.849-1.587-5.946.003-6.556 5.338-11.891 11.893-11.891 3.181.001 6.167 1.24 8.413 3.488 2.245 2.248 3.481 5.236 3.48 8.414-.003 6.557-5.338 11.892-11.893 11.892-1.99-.001-3.951-.5-5.688-1.448l-6.305 1.654zm6.597-3.807c1.676.995 3.276 1.591 5.392 1.592 5.448 0 9.886-4.434 9.889-9.885.002-5.462-4.415-9.89-9.881-9.892-5.452 0-9.887 4.434-9.889 9.884-.001 2.225.651 3.891 1.746 5.634l-.999 3.648 3.742-.981zm11.387-5.464c-.074-.124-.272-.198-.57-.347-.297-.149-1.758-.87-2.031-.97-.272-.099-.47-.149-.669.149-.198.297-.768.97-.941 1.168-.173.198-.347.223-.644.074-.297-.149-1.255-.462-2.39-1.305-.88-.653-1.473-1.46-1.646-1.758-.173-.297-.018-.458.13-.606.134-.133.297-.347.446-.52.151-.172.2-.296.3-.495.099-.198.05-.372-.025-.52-.075-.149-.669-1.611-.916-2.206-.242-.579-.487-.501-.669-.51l-.57-.01c-.198 0-.52.074-.792.347-.272.297-1.04 1.016-1.04 2.479 0 1.463 1.065 2.876 1.213 3.074.149.198 2.096 3.2 5.077 4.487.709.306 1.263.489 1.694.626.712.226 1.36.194 1.872.118.571-.085 1.758-.719 2.006-1.413.248-.695.248-1.29.173-1.414z"/></svg>
                    </a>`;
                });
            }

            const supportBtn = document.getElementById('active-support-btn');
            if (supportBtn) {
                supportBtn.href = `https://wa.me/${currentSede.supportPhone}?text=Ayuda%20necesito%20asistencia%20en%20el%20sal%C3%B3n%20de%20Cap%C3%ADtulo%20Dos`;
            }

            // Llenar las fechas reales en la agenda del portal activo
            if (currentSede.startDateStr) {
                const baseDate = new Date(currentSede.startDateStr);
                const monthNames = ["ene", "feb", "mar", "abr", "may", "jun", "jul", "ago", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dic"];
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    const dayDate = new Date(baseDate.getTime() + (i * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                    const dayEl = document.getElementById(`agenda-day-${i + 1}`);
                    if (dayEl) {
                        dayEl.innerText = `${dayDate.getDate()} ${monthNames[dayDate.getMonth()]}`;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // CARGA DINÁMICA DE FECHAS DESDE CALENDARIO C2
        // ==========================================
        let targetStartDate = 0;
        let targetTransitionDate = 0;
        let currentState = 'PRE-TRAINING'; // 'PRE-TRAINING' | 'TRANSITION' | 'ACTIVE'

        async function fetchAndInitC2Dates() {
            try {
                const now = testTimeOverride ? new Date(testTimeOverride) : new Date();
                const response = await fetch('calendario_c2.json');
                const calendarData = await response.json();
                
                const datesArray = calendarData[sedeCode] || calendarData['LIM'];
                let nextEvent = null;
                const targetEquipo = urlParams.get('equipo');
                
                if (datesArray) {
                    for (const eventObj of datesArray) {
                        const startDateStr = typeof eventObj === 'string' ? eventObj : eventObj.start;
                        if (!startDateStr) continue;
                        
                        if (targetEquipo && typeof eventObj !== 'string' && eventObj.equipo !== targetEquipo) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        const dObj = new Date(startDateStr);
                        // El evento caduca el domingo a las 20:00 (sumamos 79 horas desde jueves 13:00)
                        const expirationTime = new Date(dObj.getTime() + (79 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                        
                        if (expirationTime > now) {
                            nextEvent = eventObj;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (nextEvent) {
                    const startObj = new Date(nextEvent.start);
                    const transitionObj = new Date(startObj.getTime() + (2 * 60 * 60 * 1000)); // Jueves 15:00
                    const endObj = new Date(startObj.getTime() + (3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)); // Domingo

                    const monthNames = ["enero", "febrero", "marzo", "abril", "mayo", "junio", "julio", "agosto", "septiembre", "octubre", "noviembre", "diciembre"];
                    
                    const startDay = startObj.getDate();
                    const endDay = endObj.getDate();
                    const startMonth = monthNames[startObj.getMonth()];
                    const endMonth = monthNames[endObj.getMonth()];
                    const year = startObj.getFullYear();
                    
                    if (startMonth === endMonth) {
                        currentSede.heroDate = `Del jueves ${startDay} al domingo ${endDay}`;
                        currentSede.heroMonth = `de ${startMonth} de ${year}`;
                    } else {
                        currentSede.heroDate = `Del jueves ${startDay} de ${startMonth} al domingo ${endDay}`;
                        currentSede.heroMonth = `de ${endMonth} de ${year}`;
                    }
                    
                    if (nextEvent.equipo) {
                        currentSede.team = isNaN(nextEvent.equipo) ? nextEvent.equipo : `Equipo ${nextEvent.equipo}`;
                    }
                    currentSede.startDateStr = startObj.toISOString();
                    currentSede.transitionDateStr = transitionObj.toISOString();
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Error fetching C2 dates, using fallback:", err);
            }
            
            renderSedeData();
            
            targetStartDate = new Date(currentSede.startDateStr).getTime();
            targetTransitionDate = new Date(currentSede.transitionDateStr).getTime();

            setInterval(checkSystemState, 1000);
            
            let nowInitial = testTimeOverride ? new Date(testTimeOverride).getTime() : new Date().getTime();
            if (nowInitial >= targetTransitionDate) {
                document.getElementById('pre-training-container').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('pre-training-container').style.opacity = '0';
                const portal = document.getElementById('portal-active-container');
                portal.style.display = 'block';
                portal.style.opacity = '1';
                currentState = 'ACTIVE';
            } else {
                checkSystemState();
            }
        }

        function checkSystemState() {
            let now = testTimeOverride ? new Date(testTimeOverride).getTime() : new Date().getTime();

            if (currentState === 'PRE-TRAINING') {
                const diffStart = targetStartDate - now;
                if (diffStart > 0) {
                    const dias = Math.floor(diffStart / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const horas = Math.floor((diffStart % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    document.getElementById('dias').innerText = dias;
                    document.getElementById('horas').innerText = horas.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('dias').innerText = '0';
                    document.getElementById('horas').innerText = '00';
                }
                
                if (now >= targetTransitionDate && targetTransitionDate !== 0) {
                    initiateWarpTransition();
                }
            }
        }

        function initiateWarpTransition() {
            if (currentState === 'TRANSITION' || currentState === 'ACTIVE') return;
            currentState = 'TRANSITION';
            
            const overlay = document.getElementById('warp-transition-overlay');
            const text = document.getElementById('warp-text');
            const preContainer = document.getElementById('pre-training-container');
            const activeContainer = document.getElementById('portal-active-container');
            
            overlay.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(() => {
                overlay.style.opacity = '1';
                text.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'scale-50');
                text.classList.add('opacity-100', 'scale-100');
            }, 50);

            setTimeout(() => {
                preContainer.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    preContainer.style.display = 'none';
                    activeContainer.style.display = 'block';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        activeContainer.style.opacity = '1';
                    }, 50);
                }, 1000);
            }, 1000);

            setTimeout(() => {
                text.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'scale-100');
                text.classList.add('opacity-0', 'scale-150');
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    overlay.style.display = 'none';
                    currentState = 'ACTIVE';
                }, 1000);
            }, 4000);
        }

        fetchAndInitC2Dates();

        // ==========================================
        // TABS DEL PORTAL ACTIVO Y BITÁCORA
        // ==========================================
        const btnSchedule = document.getElementById('tab-btn-schedule');
        const btnJournal = document.getElementById('tab-btn-journal');
        const contentSchedule = document.getElementById('tab-content-schedule');
        const contentJournal = document.getElementById('tab-content-journal');
        const journalTextArea = document.getElementById('reflection-journal');
        const journalStatus = document.getElementById('journal-status');

        if (btnSchedule && btnJournal) {
            btnSchedule.addEventListener('click', () => {
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('bg-crearDark/50', 'bg-crearCyan');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('text-gray-400', 'text-crearDarker');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('border', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]');
                
                btnJournal.classList.replace('bg-crearCyan', 'bg-crearDark/50');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('text-crearDarker', 'text-gray-400');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]', 'border');

                contentSchedule.classList.remove('hidden');
                contentJournal.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            btnJournal.addEventListener('click', () => {
                btnJournal.classList.replace('bg-crearDark/50', 'bg-crearCyan');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('text-gray-400', 'text-crearDarker');
                btnJournal.classList.replace('border', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]');
                
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('bg-crearCyan', 'bg-crearDark/50');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('text-crearDarker', 'text-gray-400');
                btnSchedule.classList.replace('shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,210,255,0.4)]', 'border');

                contentJournal.classList.remove('hidden');
                contentSchedule.classList.add('hidden');
            });
        }

        if (journalTextArea) {
            const savedData = localStorage.getItem('cpsl_journal_c2');
            if (savedData) {
                journalTextArea.value = savedData;
            }

            let timeoutId;
            journalTextArea.addEventListener('input', () => {
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                journalStatus.style.opacity = '0';
                
                timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                    localStorage.setItem('cpsl_journal_c2', journalTextArea.value);
                    journalStatus.style.opacity = '1';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        journalStatus.style.opacity = '0';
                    }, 2000);
                }, 1000);
            });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // GESTIÓN DEL MODAL DE MAESTRÍA
        // ==========================================
        function openMaestriaModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('maestria-modal');
            const content = document.getElementById('maestria-modal-content');
            
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            setTimeout(() => {
                modal.classList.remove('opacity-0');
                content.classList.remove('scale-95');
            }, 10);
        }
        
        function closeMaestriaModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('maestria-modal');
            const content = document.getElementById('maestria-modal-content');
            
            modal.classList.add('opacity-0');
            content.classList.add('scale-95');
            setTimeout(() => {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }, 300);
        }

        // ==========================================
        // SISTEMA DE BIENESTAR VISUAL Y GARANTÍA DE LECTURA
        // ==========================================
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
            const scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - document.documentElement.clientHeight;
            const progress = scrollHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / scrollHeight) * 100 : 0;
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('scroll-progress-bar');
            if (progressBar) {
                progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
            }
        });

        const assistantTrigger = document.getElementById('assistant-trigger');
        const assistantPanel = document.getElementById('assistant-panel');
        const assistantClose = document.getElementById('assistant-close');

        if (assistantTrigger && assistantPanel && assistantClose) {
            assistantTrigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                assistantPanel.classList.toggle('hidden');
            });

            assistantClose.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                assistantPanel.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            assistantPanel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
            });

            document.addEventListener('click', () => {
                assistantPanel.classList.add('hidden');
            });
        }

        // Regla Láser
        const btnRuler = document.getElementById('btn-ruler');
        const rulerEl = document.getElementById('reading-ruler');
        let rulerActive = false;

        if (btnRuler && rulerEl) {
            btnRuler.addEventListener('click', () => {
                rulerActive = !rulerActive;
                if (rulerActive) {
                    rulerEl.style.display = 'block';
                    btnRuler.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnRuler.classList.add('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnRuler.innerText = 'Activo';
                } else {
                    rulerEl.style.display = 'none';
                    btnRuler.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnRuler.classList.remove('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnRuler.innerText = 'Activar';
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                if (rulerActive) {
                    rulerEl.style.transform = `translateY(${e.clientY - 1.5}px)`;
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
                if (rulerActive && e.touches.length > 0) {
                    rulerEl.style.transform = `translateY(${e.touches[0].clientY - 1.5}px)`;
                }
            });
        }

        // Enfoque por Bloques
        const btnFocus = document.getElementById('btn-focus');
        let focusActive = false;

        if (btnFocus) {
            btnFocus.addEventListener('click', () => {
                focusActive = !focusActive;
                if (focusActive) {
                    document.body.classList.add('block-focus-active');
                    btnFocus.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnFocus.classList.add('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnFocus.innerText = 'Activo';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('block-focus-active');
                    btnFocus.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnFocus.classList.remove('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnFocus.innerText = 'Activar';
                }
            });
        }

        // Sepia Anti-Fatiga
        const btnWarm = document.getElementById('btn-warm');
        let warmActive = false;

        if (btnWarm) {
            btnWarm.addEventListener('click', () => {
                warmActive = !warmActive;
                if (warmActive) {
                    document.body.classList.add('warm-reading-active');
                    btnWarm.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnWarm.classList.add('bg-crearGold', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#ffb703]');
                    btnWarm.innerText = 'Activo';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('warm-reading-active');
                    btnWarm.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnWarm.classList.remove('bg-crearGold', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#ffb703]');
                    btnWarm.innerText = 'Activar';
                }
            });
        }

        // Texto Grande
        const btnTextSize = document.getElementById('btn-text-size');
        let textLargeActive = false;

        if (btnTextSize) {
            btnTextSize.addEventListener('click', () => {
                textLargeActive = !textLargeActive;
                if (textLargeActive) {
                    document.body.classList.add('large-text-active');
                    btnTextSize.classList.remove('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnTextSize.classList.add('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnTextSize.innerText = 'Grande';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('large-text-active');
                    btnTextSize.classList.add('bg-gray-800/80', 'text-gray-400');
                    btnTextSize.classList.remove('bg-crearCyan', 'text-crearDarker', 'shadow-[0_0_10px_#00d2ff]');
                    btnTextSize.innerText = 'Normal';
                }
            });
        }

        // Lógica de "Garantía de Lectura Obligatoria"
        const readingSections = [
            { id: 'grid-info-section', step: 1 },
            { id: 'que-traer-section', step: 2 },
            { id: 'normas-convivencia-section', step: 3 },
            { id: 'compromiso-proceso-section', step: 4 }
        ];

        const readSections = { 1: false, 2: false, 3: false, 4: false };
        const sectionDwellTimes = {};

        function markSectionAsRead(step) {
            if (readSections[step]) return;
            readSections[step] = true;

            const checkEl = document.getElementById(`check-step-${step}`);
            const statusEl = document.getElementById(`status-step-${step}`);

            if (checkEl) {
                checkEl.classList.remove('border-gray-600', 'text-gray-500');
                checkEl.classList.add('bg-green-500/20', 'border-green-500', 'text-green-400');
                checkEl.innerText = '✓';
            }

            if (statusEl) {
                statusEl.classList.remove('text-gray-500');
                statusEl.classList.add('text-green-400', 'font-bold');
                statusEl.innerText = 'Leído';
            }

            updateReadingCompletion();
        }

        function updateReadingCompletion() {
            const completedCount = Object.values(readSections).filter(Boolean).length;
            const percentage = Math.round((completedCount / 4) * 100);

            const badgeEl = document.getElementById('assistant-badge');
            const progressTextEl = document.getElementById('panel-progress-text');

            if (badgeEl) {
                badgeEl.innerText = `${percentage}%`;
                if (percentage === 100) {
                    badgeEl.classList.remove('bg-crearRed', 'animate-bounce');
                    badgeEl.classList.add('bg-green-500');
                    badgeEl.innerText = '✓';
                }
            }

            if (progressTextEl) {
                progressTextEl.innerText = `${percentage}%`;
                if (percentage === 100) {
                    progressTextEl.classList.remove('text-crearCyan');
                    progressTextEl.classList.add('text-green-400');
                }
            }

            if (percentage === 100) {
                unlockConfirmation();
            }
        }

        function unlockConfirmation() {
            const bannerEl = document.getElementById('completion-banner');
            if (bannerEl) {
                bannerEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                bannerEl.classList.add('block');
            }

            const waButtons = document.querySelectorAll('#coordinators-container a');
            waButtons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.add('completion-glow');
            });

            const heroBtn = document.querySelector('a[href="#contacto"]');
            if (heroBtn) {
                heroBtn.classList.add('completion-glow');
                heroBtn.innerHTML = '✨ ¡LECTURA COMPLETADA! CONFIRMAR ASISTENCIA AL CAPÍTULO DOS';
            }
        }

        const observerOptions = {
            root: null,
            rootMargin: '0px',
            threshold: 0.15
        };

        const readingObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                const sectionId = entry.target.id;
                const sectionConfig = readingSections.find(s => s.id === sectionId);
                if (!sectionConfig) return;

                const step = sectionConfig.step;

                if (entry.isIntersecting && !readSections[step]) {
                    sectionDwellTimes[step] = setTimeout(() => {
                        markSectionAsRead(step);
                    }, 1800);
                } else {
                    if (sectionDwellTimes[step]) {
                        clearTimeout(sectionDwellTimes[step]);
                        delete sectionDwellTimes[step];
                    }
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        readingSections.forEach(sec => {
            const el = document.getElementById(sec.id);
            if (el) readingObserver.observe(el);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script>
        function reveal() {
            var reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
            for (var i = 0; i < reveals.length; i++) {
                var windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
                var elementTop = reveals[i].getBoundingClientRect().top;
                var elementVisible = 100;
                if (elementTop < windowHeight - elementVisible) {
                    reveals[i].classList.add("active");
                }
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener("scroll", reveal);
        // Disparar reveal inicial
        setTimeout(reveal, 100);
    </script>
```

## Archivo: public/cartas/carta-sedes.js

```js
(function () {
  const base = new URL('.', document.currentScript.src);
  const keys = ['razonSocial', 'identificacionFiscal', 'direccionFiscal', 'correoContacto', 'telefonoContacto'];
  const normalize = value => String(value || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const sedeId = value => {
    const s = normalize(value);
    if (s.includes('quito') || s.startsWith('uio')) return 'quito';
    if (s === 'lim' || s.includes('lima')) return 'lima';
    if (s === 'cue' || s.includes('cuenca')) return 'cuenca';
    if (s === 'gye' || s.includes('guayaquil')) return 'guayaquil';
    if (s === 'med' || s.includes('medellin')) return 'medellin';
    if (s === 'mex' || s === 'cdmx' || s.includes('mexico')) return 'mexico';
    return '';
  };
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'no-print max-w-4xl mx-auto mb-4 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl';
    const label = document.createElement('label'); label.textContent = 'Sede de destino: ';
    const select = document.createElement('select'); select.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Sede de destino');
    const empty = document.createElement('option'); empty.value = ''; empty.textContent = 'Seleccionar sede'; select.append(empty);
    const status = document.createElement('p'); status.className = 'text-sm mt-2'; status.setAttribute('role','status');
    label.append(select); panel.append(label, status); document.body.prepend(panel);
    let catalog;
    try { const response = await fetch(new URL('sedes-institucionales.json', base), {cache:'no-store'}); if(!response.ok) throw Error(); catalog = await response.json(); }
    catch { status.textContent = 'No se pudo cargar el directorio de sedes. Recarga antes de generar la carta.'; return; }
    Object.entries(catalog).forEach(([id, data]) => { const option = document.createElement('option'); option.value=id; option.textContent=data.sede; select.append(option); });
    let revision=0;
    async function render() {
      const current=++revision, id=select.value, seed=catalog[id];
      document.getElementById('print-letter').disabled=true;
      const signature=document.getElementById('sede-signature'); signature.replaceChildren();
      if (!seed) {
        document.getElementById('sede-invitation').textContent='Selecciona la sede de destino para completar los responsables de esta invitación.';
        document.getElementById('sede-authority').textContent='A las autoridades migratorias:';
        document.getElementById('sede-city').textContent='[SEDE PENDIENTE]';
        status.textContent='Las cartas antiguas sin sede requieren seleccionarla; no se asume Lima.'; return;
      }
      status.textContent='Consultando los datos de la sede…';
      const data={...seed}; let unavailable=false;
      try {
        const response=await fetch('https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/centro-operativo-cpsl/databases/(default)/documents/sedes_institucionales/'+id, {cache:'no-store',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(6000)});
        if(response.ok) { const document=await response.json(); keys.forEach(key=>{ if(document.fields?.[key]?.stringValue !== undefined) data[key]=document.fields[key].stringValue; }); }
        else if(response.status!==404) unavailable=true;
      } catch { unavailable=true; }
      if(current!==revision)return;
      const managers=[...new Set(seed.gerentes.map(manager=>manager.nombre))];
      const names=managers.join(' y ');
      const complete=keys.every(key=>typeof data[key]==='string' && data[key].trim() && !data[key].includes('['));
      document.getElementById('sede-authority').textContent='A las autoridades migratorias de '+seed.pais+':';
      document.getElementById('sede-city').textContent=seed.ciudad+', '+seed.pais;
      document.getElementById('sede-invitation').textContent=complete
        ? `Por medio de la presente, ${data.razonSocial}, con identificación fiscal ${data.identificacionFiscal} y domicilio en ${data.direccionFiscal}, comercialmente conocida como CREAR Poder Sin Límites, sede ${seed.sede}, emite esta invitación a favor de la siguiente persona:`
        : `Por medio de la presente, ${names}, ${managers.length>1?'gerentes responsables':'gerente responsable'} de CREAR Poder Sin Límites, sede ${seed.sede}, presenta${managers.length>1?'n':''} esta invitación a favor de la siguiente persona:`;
      managers.forEach(manager=>{const name=document.createElement('p');name.className='font-bold text-gray-900 text-lg';name.textContent=manager;signature.append(name);});
      if(complete) [data.razonSocial, data.identificacionFiscal, data.direccionFiscal, [data.correoContacto,data.telefonoContacto].join(' | ')].forEach(text=>{const line=document.createElement('p');line.className='text-sm text-gray-600';line.textContent=text;signature.append(line);});
      status.textContent=(complete?'Datos institucionales registrados.':'Datos institucionales pendientes: por ahora figuran únicamente los nombres de los gerentes.')+(unavailable?' No se pudo consultar Causa OS; se muestran los datos base disponibles.':'');
      document.getElementById('print-letter').disabled=false;
      const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search);params.set('sede',id);history.replaceState(null,'','?'+params.toString());
      const hotel=document.getElementById('field-hotel');
      if (hotel) {
        if (seed.hotel) {
          hotel.textContent = seed.hotel;
        } else if (id === 'lima' || !id) {
          hotel.textContent = 'Hotel Jose Antonio Deluxe (Calle Bellavista 133, Miraflores, Lima - Código de Reserva: 32425545)';
        } else if (/^Hotel Sede /i.test(hotel.textContent)) {
          hotel.textContent = '[HOSPEDAJE PENDIENTE]';
        }
      }
    }
    select.value=sedeId(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('sede'));
    select.addEventListener('change',render); await render();
  });
})();
```
