## Archivo: src/components/NodusCoordinadoresC1C2Dashboard.css

```css
/* =========================================================================
   ESTILOS EJECUTIVOS: NODUS COORDINADORES C1 & C2 DASHBOARD
   CREAR PODER SIN LÍMITES - CAUSA OS
   SOPORTE IMPECABLE MODO DÍA, NOCHE Y AUTO
   ========================================================================= */

/* --- 1. DEFINICIÓN DE VARIABLES DE TEMA (DARK / NOCHE POR DEFECTO) --- */
.nodus-dashboard-container {
  --nodus-bg-banner: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(17, 34, 64, 0.95) 0%, rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.98) 100%);
  --nodus-border-banner: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.35);
  --nodus-banner-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

  --nodus-bg-card: rgba(17, 34, 64, 0.75);
  --nodus-bg-card-hover: rgba(23, 42, 77, 0.9);
  --nodus-border-card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --nodus-border-card-hover: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.4);
  --nodus-card-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  --nodus-card-shadow-hover: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);

  --nodus-bg-filters: rgba(17, 34, 64, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-filters: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

  --nodus-bg-input: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.8);
  --nodus-border-input: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --nodus-color-input: #ffffff;
  --nodus-placeholder-input: #64748b;

  --nodus-bg-select-item: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.8);
  --nodus-border-select-item: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --nodus-color-select: #e2e8f0;
  --nodus-bg-select-option: #0a192f;
  --nodus-color-select-option: #ffffff;

  --nodus-bg-charts: rgba(17, 34, 64, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-charts: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --nodus-chart-header-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --nodus-chart-tab-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --nodus-chart-tab-hover-color: #ffffff;
  --nodus-legend-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.7);
  --nodus-legend-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  --nodus-bg-table: rgba(17, 34, 64, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-table: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --nodus-table-header-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.6);
  --nodus-th-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.95);
  --nodus-th-color: #94a3b8;
  --nodus-th-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --nodus-td-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --nodus-tr-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  --nodus-tr-expanded: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.03);

  --nodus-btn-expand-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.9);
  --nodus-btn-expand-border: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.35);
  --nodus-btn-expand-color: #ffc107;
  --nodus-btn-expand-hover: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.2);

  --nodus-nested-wrapper-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.98);
  --nodus-nested-panel-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.95);
  --nodus-nested-border: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.25);
  --nodus-nested-th-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.9);
  --nodus-nested-th-color: #94a3b8;
  --nodus-nested-td-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);

  --nodus-text-main: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-text-title: #ffffff;
  --nodus-text-sub: #94a3b8;
  --nodus-text-muted: #64748b;
  --nodus-progress-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

  --nodus-sync-bg: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.8);
  --nodus-sync-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --nodus-sync-text: #cbd5e1;

  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body, 'Inter', sans-serif);
  color: var(--nodus-text-main);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* --- 2. OVERRIDES PARA MODO DÍA (LIGHT MODE) --- */
[data-theme="light"] .nodus-dashboard-container,
.theme-light .nodus-dashboard-container {
  --nodus-bg-banner: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  --nodus-border-banner: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.35);
  --nodus-banner-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);

  --nodus-bg-card: #ffffff;
  --nodus-bg-card-hover: #fcfcfd;
  --nodus-border-card: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  --nodus-border-card-hover: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.45);
  --nodus-card-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  --nodus-card-shadow-hover: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

  --nodus-bg-filters: #ffffff;
  --nodus-border-filters: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);

  --nodus-bg-input: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-border-input: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
  --nodus-color-input: #0f172a;
  --nodus-placeholder-input: #94a3b8;

  --nodus-bg-select-item: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-border-select-item: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);
  --nodus-color-select: #0f172a;
  --nodus-bg-select-option: #ffffff;
  --nodus-color-select-option: #0f172a;

  --nodus-bg-charts: #ffffff;
  --nodus-border-charts: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  --nodus-chart-header-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);
  --nodus-chart-tab-hover: #f1f5f9;
  --nodus-chart-tab-hover-color: #0f172a;
  --nodus-legend-bg: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-legend-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);

  --nodus-bg-table: #ffffff;
  --nodus-border-table: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  --nodus-table-header-bg: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-th-bg: #f1f5f9;
  --nodus-th-color: #475569;
  --nodus-th-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  --nodus-td-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  --nodus-tr-hover: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-tr-expanded: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05);

  --nodus-btn-expand-bg: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-btn-expand-border: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.4);
  --nodus-btn-expand-color: #b45309;
  --nodus-btn-expand-hover: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);

  --nodus-nested-wrapper-bg: #f8fafc;
  --nodus-nested-panel-bg: #ffffff;
  --nodus-nested-border: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.3);
  --nodus-nested-th-bg: #f1f5f9;
  --nodus-nested-th-color: #475569;
  --nodus-nested-td-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);

  --nodus-text-main: #0f172a;
  --nodus-text-title: #0f172a;
  --nodus-text-sub: #475569;
  --nodus-text-muted: #64748b;
  --nodus-progress-bg: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);

  --nodus-sync-bg: #f1f5f9;
  --nodus-sync-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  --nodus-sync-text: #334155;
}

/* --- 2.1 OVERRIDES PARA MODO ZEN (FOREST / BOTANICAL HARMONY) --- */
[data-theme="zen"] .nodus-dashboard-container,
.theme-zen .nodus-dashboard-container {
  --nodus-bg-banner: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(12, 32, 26, 0.95) 0%, rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.98) 100%);
  --nodus-border-banner: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.35);
  --nodus-banner-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1);

  --nodus-bg-card: rgba(12, 32, 26, 0.78);
  --nodus-bg-card-hover: rgba(18, 46, 38, 0.9);
  --nodus-border-card: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
  --nodus-border-card-hover: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45);
  --nodus-card-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --nodus-card-shadow-hover: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

  --nodus-bg-filters: rgba(12, 32, 26, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-filters: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);

  --nodus-bg-input: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-input: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2);
  --nodus-color-input: #f0fdf4;
  --nodus-placeholder-input: #6ee7b7;

  --nodus-bg-select-item: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-select-item: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2);
  --nodus-color-select: #f0fdf4;
  --nodus-bg-select-option: #0c201a;
  --nodus-color-select-option: #f0fdf4;

  --nodus-bg-charts: rgba(12, 32, 26, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-charts: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
  --nodus-chart-header-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12);
  --nodus-chart-tab-hover: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);
  --nodus-chart-tab-hover-color: #f0fdf4;
  --nodus-legend-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.75);
  --nodus-legend-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12);

  --nodus-bg-table: rgba(12, 32, 26, 0.85);
  --nodus-border-table: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
  --nodus-table-header-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.7);
  --nodus-th-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.95);
  --nodus-th-color: #a7f3d0;
  --nodus-th-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
  --nodus-td-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);
  --nodus-tr-hover: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.05);
  --nodus-tr-expanded: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);

  --nodus-btn-expand-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.9);
  --nodus-btn-expand-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.35);
  --nodus-btn-expand-color: #34d399;
  --nodus-btn-expand-hover: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2);

  --nodus-nested-wrapper-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.98);
  --nodus-nested-panel-bg: rgba(12, 32, 26, 0.95);
  --nodus-nested-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25);
  --nodus-nested-th-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.9);
  --nodus-nested-th-color: #a7f3d0;
  --nodus-nested-td-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.06);

  --nodus-text-main: #f0fdf4;
  --nodus-text-title: #f0fdf4;
  --nodus-text-sub: #a7f3d0;
  --nodus-text-muted: #6ee7b7;
  --nodus-progress-bg: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);

  --nodus-sync-bg: rgba(7, 21, 17, 0.85);
  --nodus-sync-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2);
  --nodus-sync-text: #a7f3d0;
}

.nodus-dashboard-container *,
.nodus-dashboard-container *::before,
.nodus-dashboard-container *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* --- 3. HEADER BANNER EJECUTIVO --- */
.nodus-header-banner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  background: var(--nodus-bg-banner);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-banner);
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: var(--nodus-banner-shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-header-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.nodus-header-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.35);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #ffc107;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nodus-header-title {
  font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Montserrat', sans-serif);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--nodus-text-title);
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-badge-live {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.18);
  color: #d97706;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.4);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-live {
  color: #ffc107;
}

.nodus-header-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--nodus-text-sub);
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0 0;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-header-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.nodus-sync-indicator {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
  background: var(--nodus-sync-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-sync-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--nodus-sync-text);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-pulse-dot {
  position: relative;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #10b981;
}

.nodus-pulse-dot::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -2px;
  left: -2px;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5);
  animation: pulse-ring 2s infinite ease-out;
}

@keyframes pulse-ring {
  0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0.8; }
  100% { transform: scale(2.4); opacity: 0; }
}

.nodus-btn-refresh {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding: 0.48rem 0.9rem;
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.4);
  color: #b45309;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-btn-refresh {
  color: #ffc107;
}

.nodus-btn-refresh:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.25);
  border-color: #ffc107;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nodus-btn-refresh:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* --- 4. SCORECARDS EJECUTIVAS --- */
.nodus-scorecards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  width: 100%;
}

@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .nodus-scorecards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .nodus-scorecards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .nodus-scorecards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.nodus-card {
  background: var(--nodus-bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-card);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: var(--nodus-card-shadow);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.nodus-card:hover {
  background: var(--nodus-bg-card-hover);
  border-color: var(--nodus-border-card-hover);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--nodus-card-shadow-hover);
}

.nodus-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--nodus-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.nodus-card-value {
  font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Montserrat', sans-serif);
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--nodus-text-title);
  line-height: 1.2;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-card-value.highlight-emerald {
  color: #10b981;
}

.nodus-card-value.highlight-sky {
  color: #0284c7;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-card-value.highlight-sky {
  color: #38bdf8;
}

.nodus-card-value.highlight-gold {
  color: #d97706;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-card-value.highlight-gold {
  color: #f59e0b;
}

.nodus-card-value.highlight-purple {
  color: #7c3aed;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-card-value.highlight-purple {
  color: #a855f7;
}

.nodus-card-footer {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--nodus-text-muted);
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
}

.nodus-progress-bar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--nodus-progress-bg);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.nodus-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.5s ease-in-out;
}

/* --- 5. BARRA DE FILTROS MULTIDIMENSIONALES --- */
.nodus-filters-bar {
  background: var(--nodus-bg-filters);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-filters);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: var(--nodus-card-shadow);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-filters-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.nodus-search-box {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 250px;
  position: relative;
}

.nodus-search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0.85rem;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--nodus-text-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.nodus-search-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem 0.55rem 2.4rem;
  background: var(--nodus-bg-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-input);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--nodus-color-input);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nodus-search-input:focus {
  border-color: #ffc107;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.2);
}

.nodus-search-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--nodus-placeholder-input);
}

.nodus-select-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.nodus-select-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: var(--nodus-bg-select-item);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-select-item);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nodus-select {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--nodus-color-select);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.nodus-select option {
  background: var(--nodus-bg-select-option);
  color: var(--nodus-color-select-option);
}

/* --- 6. SECCIÓN DE GRÁFICOS RECHARTS --- */
.nodus-charts-section {
  background: var(--nodus-bg-charts);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-charts);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--nodus-card-shadow);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-charts-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-chart-header-border);
  padding-bottom: 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.nodus-chart-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.nodus-chart-tab-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--nodus-text-muted);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nodus-chart-tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--nodus-chart-tab-hover-color);
  background: var(--nodus-chart-tab-hover);
}

.nodus-chart-tab-btn.active-tab {
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.15);
  color: #b45309;
  border-color: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.15);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-chart-tab-btn.active-tab {
  color: #ffc107;
}

.nodus-chart-viewport {
  width: 100%;
  height: 380px;
  min-height: 380px;
  position: relative;
}

.nodus-pie-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-around;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.nodus-pie-chart-box {
  width: 55%;
  height: 350px;
}

.nodus-pie-legend-box {
  width: 40%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .nodus-pie-chart-box,
  .nodus-pie-legend-box {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

.nodus-legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem;
  background: var(--nodus-legend-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-legend-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

/* --- 7. TABLA DE COORDINADORES EJECUTIVA --- */
.nodus-table-container {
  background: var(--nodus-bg-table);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-border-table);
  border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--nodus-card-shadow);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-table-header {
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-chart-header-border);
  background: var(--nodus-table-header-bg);
}

.nodus-table-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Montserrat', sans-serif);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--nodus-text-title);
}

.nodus-table-scroll {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.nodus-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 880px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.nodus-th {
  background: var(--nodus-th-bg);
  color: var(--nodus-th-color);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-th-border);
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nodus-td {
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-td-border);
  vertical-align: middle;
  color: var(--nodus-text-main);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nodus-tr {
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.nodus-tr:hover {
  background: var(--nodus-tr-hover);
}

.nodus-tr.expanded-row {
  background: var(--nodus-tr-expanded);
}

/* Badges y Elementos de Celda */
.nodus-coord-avatar {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.4);
  color: #b45309;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-coord-avatar {
  color: #ffc107;
}

.nodus-badge-c1c2 {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2);
  color: #7c3aed;
  border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4);
  font-weight: 600;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-c1c2 {
  color: #a78bfa;
}

.nodus-badge-confirmados {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35);
  color: #059669;
  font-weight: 800;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-confirmados {
  color: #10b981;
}

.nodus-badge-asistieron {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
  color: #059669;
  font-weight: 800;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-asistieron {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.22);
  color: #10b981;
  border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
}

.nodus-badge-sentados-c1 {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
  color: #b45309;
  font-weight: 800;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-sentados-c1 {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
  color: #f59e0b;
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45);
}

.nodus-badge-sentados-c2 {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.35);
  color: #7c3aed;
  font-weight: 800;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-sentados-c2 {
  background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2);
  color: #a855f7;
  border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.45);
}

.nodus-badge-c1-small {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  color: #b45309;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
  margin-left: 0.4rem;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-c1-small {
  color: #f59e0b;
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
}

.nodus-badge-c2-small {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.18);
  color: #7c3aed;
  border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.35);
  margin-left: 0.4rem;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-badge-c2-small {
  color: #a855f7;
  border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.45);
}

.nodus-btn-expand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.38rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--nodus-btn-expand-bg);
  color: var(--nodus-btn-expand-color);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-btn-expand-border);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nodus-btn-expand:hover {
  background: var(--nodus-btn-expand-hover);
  border-color: #ffc107;
}

.nodus-btn-expand.expanded {
  background: #ffc107;
  color: #0a192f;
  border-color: #ffc107;
}

/* Sub-tabla anidada de equipos */
.nodus-nested-wrapper {
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  background: var(--nodus-nested-wrapper-bg);
  transition: background 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-nested-panel {
  background: var(--nodus-nested-panel-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--nodus-nested-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1rem;
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nodus-nested-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-chart-header-border);
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.nodus-nested-title {
  color: #d97706;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  margin: 0;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .nodus-nested-title {
  color: #ffc107;
}

.nodus-nested-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.nodus-nested-th {
  background: var(--nodus-nested-th-bg);
  color: var(--nodus-nested-th-color);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-nested-td-border);
}

.nodus-nested-td {
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nodus-nested-td-border);
  color: var(--nodus-text-main);
}

/* --- 5.1 BARRA DE FILTROS ACTIVOS Y CHIPS --- */
.nodus-active-filters-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--nodus-border-filters);
  animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.nodus-active-filters-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--nodus-text-muted);
}

.nodus-filter-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.14);
  color: #ffc107;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.35);
  cursor: pointer;
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Search, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import UserProfileModal from './UserProfileModal';
import { getAllCompanyUsers } from '../services/userService';
import { getFlagForSede } from '../utils/flags';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

export default function GlobalSearch() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [selectedUser, setSelectedUser] = useState(null);
  const wrapperRef = useRef(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        const u = await getAllCompanyUsers(currentUser);
        setUsers(u);
      } catch(e) {}
    }
    load();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }
    const q = query.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
    const filtered = users.filter(u => {
      const n = (u.name || u.nombre || u.displayName || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
      const r = (u.role || u.rol || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
      const s = (u.sede || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
      return n.includes(q) || r.includes(q) || s.includes(q) || (u.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
    });
    setResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));
  }, [query, users]);

  return (
    <div ref={wrapperRef} style={{ position: 'relative', width: '300px', zIndex: 100 }}>
      {selectedUser && (
        <UserProfileModal 
          isOpen={!!selectedUser} 
          onClose={() => setSelectedUser(null)} 
          user={selectedUser} 
          onStatusUpdated={(updated) => setSelectedUser(prev => ({ ...prev, ...updated }))}
        />
      )}
      <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <Search size={16} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '10px', top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
        <input 
          type="text" 
          placeholder="Buscar persona en la red Causa..."
          value={query}
          onChange={e => { setQuery(e.target.value); setIsOpen(true); }}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
            padding: '0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem 2.2rem',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            color: 'var(--text-heading)',
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        />
        {query && <X size={14} onClick={() => {setQuery(''); setIsOpen(false)}} style={{ position: 'absolute', right: '10px', top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />}
      </div>

      {isOpen && query.trim() && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: '100%',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          marginTop: '0.5rem',
          background: 'var(--bg-panel)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
          borderRadius: '12px',
          boxShadow: '0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
          maxHeight: '400px',
          overflowY: 'auto'
        }}>
          {results.length > 0 ? results.map((r, i) => {
            const hasPhone = r.whatsapp || r.phone || r.telefono || r.cleanPhone;
            const phoneVal = (r.whatsappUrl ? r.whatsappUrl.split('phone=')[1] : null) || r.cleanPhone || r.phone || r.telefono || r.whatsapp;
            const phoneStr = (phoneVal || '').toString().replace(/\D/g, '');
            const phoneUrl = r.whatsappUrl || (phoneStr ? `https://wa.me/${phoneStr}` : null);
            const chatUrl = r.email ? `https://chat.google.com/dm/${r.email}` : null;
            const rolesArr = (r.roles && r.roles.length > 0) ? r.roles : [r.role || r.rol || 'Sin cargo'];
            const roleLabel = rolesArr.map(rl => rl.replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase()).join(' • ');

            return (
              <div 
                key={r.id || i}
                style={{
                  padding: '0.8rem',
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '0.5rem',
                  transition: 'background 0.2s', cursor: 'pointer'
                }}
                className="hover-glow"
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsOpen(false);
                  setQuery('');
                  setSelectedUser(r);
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'var(--text-heading)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '5px' }}>
                    {getFlagForSede(r.sede)} {r.name || r.nombre || r.displayName || 'Usuario'}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: 'var(--crear-gold)', fontWeight: 'bold', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                    {roleLabel} {r.sede ? `• ${r.sede}` : ''}
                  </div>
                  {(r.email || hasPhone) && (
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
                      {chatUrl && (
                        <a href={chatUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ display: 'inline-block', padding: '0.2rem 0.5rem', background: 'rgba(0,191,255,0.1)', color: 'var(--crear-blue)', borderRadius: '4px', fontSize: '0.7rem', textDecoration: 'none', border: '1px solid rgba(0,191,255,0.2)' }}>
                          Google Chat
                        </a>
                      )}
                      {phoneUrl && (
                        <a href={phoneUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ display: 'inline-block', padding: '0.2rem 0.5rem', background: 'rgba(37,211,102,0.1)', color: '#25D366', borderRadius: '4px', fontSize: '0.7rem', textDecoration: 'none', border: '1px solid rgba(37,211,102,0.2)' }}>
                          WhatsApp
                        </a>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          }) : (
            <div style={{ padding: '1.5rem', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              No se encontró a nadie con "{query}"
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../services/firebase';
import { useCycles } from '../context/CyclesContext';
import { buildOperationalReview, REVIEW_SOURCE } from '../services/operationalReview';

export function OperationalReviewView({ events, snapshot, loading, error, onReload, globalFilterSede = 'Todas', now = Date.now() }) {
  const review = buildOperationalReview(events, snapshot, now);
  const groups = review.sedes.filter(group => globalFilterSede === 'Todas' || group.sede === globalFilterSede);
  return (
    <section className="glass-panel" style={{ padding: '1rem', marginBottom: '1rem' }} aria-label="Revisión de seis equipos por sede">
      <h2>Últimos seis equipos por sede · evidencia operativa</h2>
      <p>Fuente: {REVIEW_SOURCE}. Publicado: {typeof review.timestamp === 'string' ? review.timestamp : 'Fecha no verificable'} · {review.freshness.label}.</p>
      <p>Período: desde el inicio C1 más antiguo hasta el más reciente de la selección de cada sede.
        Se excluyen futuros; identidad sede + equipo explícito y orden por primera fecha C1 del calendario oficial, no por número global.
        La fecha del snapshot no acredita el período de cada gestión.</p>
      <p>Fer Aragon (CEO) y Paul Sosa (CCO): revisión institucional compartida, no desempeño personal.
        KPI personal, fórmula, meta y período aprobados: <strong>no verificables en estas fuentes</strong>.
        No se les atribuyen los totales de coordinadores ni se usan metas genéricas de gerencia.</p>
      <button type="button" onClick={onReload} disabled={loading}>{loading ? 'Consultando fuentes…' : 'Volver a leer fuentes'}</button>
      {error && <p role="alert">{error} No se certifica cobertura completa.</p>}
      {!loading && !snapshot && !error && <p role="status">No existe snapshot publicado. No equivale a cero actividad.</p>}
      {loading ? <p role="status">Esperando calendario y snapshot; no se muestran conclusiones parciales.</p> : groups.map(group => {
        const evidenced = group.teams.filter(team => team.stages.every(stage => stage.status === 'ready')).length;
        return <section key={group.sede} data-review-sede={group.sede} style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}>
          <h3>{group.sede}: {group.teams.length}/6 equipos fechados · {evidenced}/6 con reporte C1 y C2 legible</h3>
          <p>Período C1: {group.teams.at(-1)?.start || 'Sin fecha'} — {group.teams[0]?.start || 'Sin fecha'}.
            {' '}{group.missingCalendarTeams > 0 && `Faltan ${group.missingCalendarTeams} equipos en el calendario accesible. `}
            {group.invalidEvents > 0 && `${group.invalidEvents} eventos excluidos por identidad/fecha no verificables. `}
            Cobertura del histórico completo de Nodus: no certificada; el publicador consulta equipos activos.</p>
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <caption>Reportes por etapa; «Sin dato» nunca significa cero</caption>
              <thead><tr><th>Equipo</th><th>Inicio C1</th><th>Etapa</th><th>Registros</th><th>Confirmados de llamada</th><th>Evidencia</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{group.teams.flatMap(team => team.stages.map(stage =>
                <tr key={`${team.team}-${stage.stage}`}>
                  <td>Equipo {team.team}</td><td>{team.start}</td><td>{stage.stage}</td>
                  <td>{stage.rows ?? 'Sin dato'}</td><td>{stage.confirmed ?? 'Sin dato'}</td><td>{stage.label}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}</tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>;
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

export default function OperationalReview({ globalFilterSede }) {
  const { events, loadingEvents } = useCycles();
  const [state, setState] = useState({ snapshot: null, loading: true, error: '' });
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setState({ snapshot: null, loading: true, error: '' });
    getDoc(doc(db, 'nodus_coordinadores_c1c2', 'latest')).then(snapshot => {
      if (!cancelled) setState({ snapshot: snapshot.exists() ? snapshot.data() : null, loading: false, error: '' });
    }).catch(error => {
      console.error('No se pudo leer la revisión operativa:', error);
      if (!cancelled) setState({ snapshot: null, loading: false, error: 'No se pudo leer Nodus; comprueba sesión, permisos o conectividad.' });
    });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [revision]);
  return <OperationalReviewView events={events || []} {...state} loading={state.loading || loadingEvents}
    globalFilterSede={globalFilterSede} onReload={() => setRevision(value => value + 1)} />;
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

  ExternalLink, Search, ShieldCheck, Zap, Database, ArrowRight,
  Sparkles, FileText, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Building2
} from 'lucide-react';
import {

  subscribeToNodusContabilidad,
  queryNodusAssistant
} from '../services/nodusLiveSyncService';

const LIMA_GRADUADOS_SHEET_ID = '1l93lhINfZtthELjOwBodoUEgk_d6A8gTb9hPGO6cOe4';

function normalizeCleanName(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .toUpperCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^A-Z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function matchPersonNames(a, b) {
  const sTokens = normalizeCleanName(a).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
  const nTokens = normalizeCleanName(b).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
  if (sTokens.length === 0 || nTokens.length === 0) return false;
  const common = sTokens.filter(t => nTokens.includes(t));
  return common.length >= Math.min(2, sTokens.length, nTokens.length) && common.length >= Math.ceil(Math.min(sTokens.length, nTokens.length) * 0.65);
}

function parseCsvRows(text) {
  const lines = String(text || '').split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim().length > 0);
  return lines.map(line => {
    if (line.includes('\t')) {
      return line.split('\t').map(c => c.trim());
    }
    const matches = line.match(/(?:^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|[^,]*)/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => {
      let val = m.replace(/^,/, '').trim();
      if (val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) {
        val = val.slice(1, -1).replace(/""/g, '"').trim();
      }
      return val;
    });
  });
}

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubCatalog = subscribeToNodusCatalog((res) => {
      if (res.ok) setCatalogData(res.data);
    });

    const unsubAliados = subscribeToNodusAliados((res) => {
      if (res.ok) setAliadosData(res.data);
    });

    const unsubContabilidad = subscribeToNodusContabilidad((res) => {
      if (res.ok) setContabilidadData(res.data);
    });

    let unsubGraduados = null;
    if (db) {
      unsubGraduados = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'graduados_lineage_master', 'latest'), (snap) => {
        if (snap.exists()) {
          setGraduadosData(snap.data());
        }
      }, () => {});
    }

    return () => {
      if (unsubCatalog) unsubCatalog();
      if (unsubAliados) unsubAliados();
      if (unsubContabilidad) unsubContabilidad();
      if (unsubGraduados) unsubGraduados();
    };
  }, []);

  const graduadosList = graduadosData?.graduados || [];

  const findGraduadoInfo = (rawName) => {
    if (!rawName || graduadosList.length === 0) return null;
    const norm = normalizeCleanName(rawName);
    if (!norm) return null;
    const exact = graduadosList.find(g => normalizeCleanName(g.nombre) === norm);
    if (exact) return exact;
    return graduadosList.find(g => matchPersonNames(g.nombre, rawName)) || null;
  };

  const handleSyncGraduadosSheetLive = async () => {
    setGradSyncLoading(true);
    setGradSyncMessage('');
    try {
      const roleMap = { M: 'Manager', A: 'Aliado', C: 'Coordinador', Q: 'Staff Quantum' };
      const fetchCsv = async (gid) => {
        const res = await fetch(`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${LIMA_GRADUADOS_SHEET_ID}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${gid}`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} en gid=${gid}`);
        return parseCsvRows(await res.text());
      };

      const [gradRows, conv32Rows, conv33Rows, staff1Rows, staff2Rows] = await Promise.all([
        fetchCsv('1933359030'),
        fetchCsv('1566198541').catch(() => []),
        fetchCsv('1421396086').catch(() => []),
        fetchCsv('74378996').catch(() => []),
        fetchCsv('97173777').catch(() => [])
      ]);

      const parsedGraduados = [];
      if (gradRows.length > 1) {
        const headers = gradRows[0];
        for (let i = 1; i < gradRows.length; i++) {
          const r = gradRows[i];
          if (!r || r.length < 2) continue;
          const nombre = (r[0] || '').trim();
          const equipoOriginal = (r[1] || '').trim();
          if (!nombre || nombre.toLowerCase().includes('crear cuantico')) continue;
          const participaciones = [];
          const rolesSummary = { manager: 0, aliado: 0, coordinador: 0, staff: 0 };
          let ultimoRol = null;
          for (let c = 2; c < Math.min(r.length, headers.length); c++) {
            const val = (r[c] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            if (val && val !== '-' && val !== 'NI' && val !== '0') {
              const edLabel = headers[c] || `E${c}`;
              const roleLabel = roleMap[val] || val;
              participaciones.push({ edicion: edLabel, rolCode: val, rolLabel: roleLabel });
              if (val === 'M') rolesSummary.manager++;
              else if (val === 'A') rolesSummary.aliado++;
              else if (val === 'C') rolesSummary.coordinador++;
              else if (val === 'Q') rolesSummary.staff++;
              ultimoRol = `${edLabel}: ${roleLabel}`;
            }
          }
          parsedGraduados.push({
            nombre,
            nombreNorm: normalizeCleanName(nombre),
            equipoOriginal,
            participaciones,
            totalParticipaciones: participaciones.length,
            rolesSummary,
            ultimoRol
          });
        }
      }

      const parseConv = (rows, label) => {
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 2; i < rows.length; i++) {
          const r = rows[i] || [];
          const nombre = (r[0] || '').trim();
          if (!nombre || nombre.toUpperCase().includes('CREADOR CUANTICO') || nombre.toUpperCase().includes('CAPITANA')) continue;
          out.push({
            nombre,
            nombreNorm: normalizeCleanName(nombre),
            equipo: (r[1] || '').trim(),
            responsable: (r[2] || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
            estado: (r[3] || '').trim().toUpperCase() || 'PENDIENTE',
            observaciones: (r[4] || '').trim(),
            grounding: (r[5] || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
            nivel: (r[6] || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
            reto1: (r[7] || r[8] || '').trim(),
            qt: (r[14] || '').trim(),
            sombras: (r[15] || '').trim(),
            edicion: label
          });
        }
        return out;
      };

      const parseStaff = (rows, capLabel) => {
        const out = [];
        const hIdx = rows.findIndex(r => (r[0] || '').toUpperCase().includes('RESP'));
        const headers = hIdx >= 0 ? rows[hIdx] : [];
        const start = hIdx >= 0 ? hIdx + 1 : 2;
        for (let i = start; i < rows.length; i++) {
          const r = rows[i] || [];
          const resp = (r[0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          const nombre = (r[1] || '').trim();
          if (!nombre || nombre.toUpperCase().includes('STAFF')) continue;
          out.push({
            responsable: resp,
            nombre,
            nombreNorm: normalizeCleanName(nombre),
            equipo: (r[2] || '').trim(),
            turno1: (r[3] || '').trim(),
            turno1Label: headers[3] || 'Turno 1',
            turno2: (r[4] || '').trim(),
            turno2Label: headers[4] || 'Turno 2',
            turno3: (r[5] || '').trim(),
            turno3Label: headers[5] || 'Turno 3',
            turno4: (r[6] || '').trim(),
            turno4Label: headers[6] || 'Turno 4 / Obs',
            observaciones: (r[7] || r[6] || '').trim(),
            capitulo: capLabel
          });
        }
        return out;
      };

      const payload = {
        ...graduadosData,
        graduados: parsedGraduados.length > 0 ? parsedGraduados : graduadosList,
        convocatoriaAliadosE32: parseConv(conv32Rows, 'C1E32'),
        convocatoriaAliadosE33: parseConv(conv33Rows, 'C1E33'),
        staffEliteCap1E32: parseStaff(staff1Rows, 'CAP 1 E32'),
        staffEliteCap2E32: parseStaff(staff2Rows, 'CAP 2 E32'),
        metadata: {
          ...(graduadosData?.metadata || {}),
          totalGraduados: parsedGraduados.length || graduadosList.length,
          sheetId: LIMA_GRADUADOS_SHEET_ID,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };

      setGraduadosData(payload);
      if (db) {
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'graduados_lineage_master', 'latest'), payload, { merge: true });
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'lima_graduados_lineage', 'latest'), payload, { merge: true }).catch(() => {});
      }
      setGradSyncMessage(`✅ Sincronizado en vivo: ${payload.graduados.length} Graduados (E4–E39), ${payload.convocatoriaAliadosE32.length} Convocatoria E32 y ${payload.staffEliteCap1E32.length + payload.staffEliteCap2E32.length} Staff Elite.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setGradSyncMessage(`⚠️ Error al sincronizar desde Google Sheet: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setGradSyncLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRunAssistantQuery = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!assistantInput.trim()) return;
    setAssistantLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await queryNodusAssistant(assistantInput, {
        aliados: aliadosData,
        contabilidad: contabilidadData
      });
      setAssistantResponse(res);
    } finally {
      setAssistantLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }, 800);
  };

  // Lista ordenada de todos los equipos extraídos de Nodus
  const allTeamsList = Object.values(aliadosData?.equipos || {})
    .sort((a, b) => Number(b.equipoId) - Number(a.equipoId));

  // Opciones completas del selector (incluyendo equipos con datos y catálogo disponible en Nodus)
  const selectorOptions = (() => {
    const map = new Map();
    allTeamsList.forEach(eq => {
      map.set(String(eq.equipoId), {
        id: String(eq.equipoId),
        nombre: eq.equipoNombre,
        hasData: true,
        hasSheetContrast: Boolean(eq.hasSheetContrast),
        pagos: eq.metrics?.pasaronC2 || 0,
        aliadosCount: eq.aliados?.length || 0
      });
    });
    (aliadosData?.equiposDisponibles || []).forEach(opt => {
      if (!map.has(String(opt.id))) {
        map.set(String(opt.id), {
          id: String(opt.id),
          nombre: opt.nombre,
          hasData: false,
          hasSheetContrast: false,
          pagos: 0,
          aliadosCount: 0
        });
      }
    });
    return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => Number(b.id) - Number(a.id));
  })();

  // Aliados del equipo seleccionado (por defecto 149 / Lima Ciclo 1)
  const currentTeamAliados = aliadosData?.equipos?.[selectedEquipoId] || aliadosData?.latestEquipo || {
    equipoId: selectedEquipoId,
    equipoNombre: selectorOptions.find(o => o.id === String(selectedEquipoId))?.nombre || `EQUIPO ID ${selectedEquipoId}`,
    metrics: {
      totalPersonas: 0,
      pxConGrupoNodus: 0,
      pasaronC2: 0,
      pagaronC2: 0,
      pagaronC2MJ: 0,
      abonos: 0,
      aliadosAsignados: 0
    },
    aliados: [],
    feedbackQT: [],
    aliadosDeclaradosC2: [],
    participantesC2Nodus: []
  };

  const handleSyncTeamSheet = async () => {
    setSheetSyncLoading(true);
    setSheetSyncStatus('');
    try {
      let csvText = sheetPasteInput.trim();
      let cleanSheetUrl = sheetUrlInput.trim() || currentTeamAliados.sheetUrl || '';

      if (!csvText && cleanSheetUrl) {
        const mId = cleanSheetUrl.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
        const mGid = cleanSheetUrl.match(/gid=(\d+)/);
        if (!mId) {
          throw new Error('URL de Google Sheet inválida. Asegúrate de pegar el enlace completo de Google Sheets.');
        }
        const sheetId = mId[1];
        const gid = mGid ? mGid[1] : '0';
        const exportUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${gid}`;
        const res = await fetch(exportUrl);
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error('La hoja tiene acceso restringido en el navegador. Copia y pega las celdas de la tabla de Aliados/QT en el cuadro inferior.');
        }
        const fetched = await res.text();
        if (fetched.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || fetched.includes('<html')) {
          throw new Error('La hoja requiere permisos o pegar directamente las celdas (Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V) en el cuadro de texto inferior.');
        }
        csvText = fetched;
      }

      if (!csvText) {
        throw new Error('Ingresa la URL de un Google Sheet público o pega las filas de la hoja de QT & Aliados.');
      }

      const rows = parseCsvRows(csvText);
      const parsedAliadosSheet = [];
      const parsedFeedbackQT = [];
      let inFeedback = false;
      let parsedTotals = null;

      for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        const r = rows[i] || [];
        const c0 = String(r[0] || '').trim();
        const c1 = String(r[1] || '').trim();
        if (c0.toUpperCase().includes('FEEDBACK QT')) {
          inFeedback = true;
          continue;
        }
        if (c0.toUpperCase() === 'QUANTUM' || c1.toUpperCase() === 'ALIADO') continue;

        if (!inFeedback) {
          if (!c0 && !c1 && (parseInt(r[2], 10) || 0) >= 15) {
            parsedTotals = {
              px: parseInt(r[2], 10) || 0,
              desertor: parseInt(r[3], 10) || 0,
              pxFin: parseInt(r[4], 10) || 0,
              declaracion: parseInt(r[5], 10) || 0,
              c2: parseInt(r[7], 10) || 0,
              c2mj: parseInt(r[8], 10) || 0,
              abono: parseInt(r[9], 10) || 0,
              pagos: parseInt(r[12], 10) || ((parseInt(r[7], 10) || 0) + (parseInt(r[8], 10) || 0)),
              pp: r[13] || '0%'
            };
            continue;
          }
          if (c0 && c1 && !c1.toUpperCase().includes('SIN GRUPO')) {
            const c2Val = parseInt(r[7], 10) || 0;
            const c2mjVal = parseInt(r[8], 10) || 0;
            const pagosVal = parseInt(r[12], 10) || (c2Val + c2mjVal);
            const pxFinVal = parseInt(r[4], 10) || (parseInt(r[2], 10) || 0);
            parsedAliadosSheet.push({
              quantum: c0,
              aliado: c1,
              px: parseInt(r[2], 10) || 0,
              desertor: parseInt(r[3], 10) || 0,
              pxFin: pxFinVal,
              declaracion: parseInt(r[5], 10) || 0,
              c2: c2Val,
              c2mj: c2mjVal,
              abono: parseInt(r[9], 10) || 0,
              pagos: pagosVal,
              pp: r[13] || (pxFinVal > 0 ? `${Math.round((pagosVal / pxFinVal) * 100)}%` : '0%')
            });
          }
        } else {
          if (c0.toUpperCase().includes('CAPITULO')) break;
          if (c0 && (parseInt(r[1], 10) || 0) > 0) {
            parsedFeedbackQT.push({
              quantum: c0,
              px: parseInt(r[1], 10) || 0,
              desertor: parseInt(r[2], 10) || 0,
              pxFin: parseInt(r[3], 10) || 0,
              declaracion: parseInt(r[4], 10) || 0,
              c2: parseInt(r[5], 10) || 0,
              c2mj: parseInt(r[6], 10) || 0,
              abono: parseInt(r[7], 10) || 0,
              pagos: parseInt(r[10], 10) || ((parseInt(r[5], 10) || 0) + (parseInt(r[6], 10) || 0)),
              pp: r[11] || '0%'
            });
          }
        }
      }

      if (parsedAliadosSheet.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No se detectaron filas con formato QUANTUM | ALIADO | PX | DESERTOR | PX FIN | DECLARACION | ... | C2 | C2+MJ.');
      }

      const nodusMap = new Map();
      (currentTeamAliados.aliados || []).forEach(a => {
        nodusMap.set(normalizeCleanName(a.aliadoNodus || a.aliado), a);
      });

      const matchedKeys = new Set();
      const contrastedAliados = parsedAliadosSheet.map(sa => {
        let matched = null;
        for (const [k, v] of nodusMap.entries()) {
          if (matchPersonNames(sa.aliado, v.aliadoNodus || v.aliado)) {
            matched = v;
            matchedKeys.add(k);
            break;
          }
        }
        const pxNodus = matched ? (matched.pxNodus ?? matched.asignados ?? 0) : 0;
        const pagosNodus = matched ? (matched.pagosNodus ?? matched.pasaronC2 ?? 0) : 0;
        return {
          quantum: sa.quantum,
          aliado: sa.aliado,
          aliadoNodus: matched?.aliadoNodus || sa.aliado,
          telefono: matched?.telefono || '',
          enNodus: Boolean(matched),
          declaradoC2Nodus: Boolean(matched?.declaradoC2Nodus),
          pxSheet: sa.px,
          pxNodus,
          desertor: sa.desertor,
          pxFin: sa.pxFin,
          declaracion: sa.declaracion,
          c2: sa.c2,
          c2mj: sa.c2mj,
          abono: sa.abono,
          pagosSheet: sa.pagos,
          pagosNodus,
          pp: sa.pp,
          cuadrado: Boolean(matched) && sa.px === pxNodus && sa.pagos === pagosNodus,
          participantesAsignados: matched?.participantesAsignados || [],
          asignados: sa.px,
          c1: sa.pxFin,
          pasaronC2: sa.declaracion,
          pagaronC2: sa.c2,
          pagaronC2MJ: sa.c2mj
        };
      });

      // Si no venía tabla FEEDBACK QT explícita, agrupar por Quantum automáticamente
      const finalFeedbackQT = parsedFeedbackQT.length > 0
        ? parsedFeedbackQT.map(qt => {
            const group = contrastedAliados.filter(a => normalizeCleanName(a.quantum) === normalizeCleanName(qt.quantum));
            const pxNodus = group.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.pxNodus || 0), 0);
            const pagosNodus = group.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.pagosNodus || 0), 0);
            return {
              ...qt,
              totalAliadosQT: group.length,
              pxNodus,
              pagosNodus,
              cuadradoConNodus: qt.px === pxNodus && qt.pagos === pagosNodus
            };
          })
        : (() => {
            const qMap = new Map();
            contrastedAliados.forEach(a => {
              const qName = a.quantum || 'SIN QT';
              if (!qMap.has(qName)) {
                qMap.set(qName, { quantum: qName, totalAliadosQT: 0, px: 0, pxNodus: 0, desertor: 0, pxFin: 0, declaracion: 0, c2: 0, c2mj: 0, abono: 0, pagos: 0, pagosNodus: 0, pp: '0%', cuadradoConNodus: true });
              }
              const q = qMap.get(qName);
              q.totalAliadosQT++;
              q.px += a.pxSheet || 0;
              q.pxNodus += a.pxNodus || 0;
              q.desertor += a.desertor || 0;
              q.pxFin += a.pxFin || 0;
              q.declaracion += a.declaracion || 0;
              q.c2 += a.c2 || 0;
              q.c2mj += a.c2mj || 0;
              q.abono += a.abono || 0;
              q.pagos += a.pagosSheet || 0;
              q.pagosNodus += a.pagosNodus || 0;
              q.pp = q.pxFin > 0 ? `${Math.round((q.pagos / q.pxFin) * 100)}%` : '0%';
              q.cuadradoConNodus = q.px === q.pxNodus && q.pagos === q.pagosNodus;
            });
            return Array.from(qMap.values());
          })();

      const sumPxSheet = parsedTotals?.px || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.pxSheet || 0), 0);
      const sumDesertores = parsedTotals?.desertor || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.desertor || 0), 0);
      const sumPxFin = parsedTotals?.pxFin || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.pxFin || 0), 0);
      const sumDecl = parsedTotals?.declaracion || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.declaracion || 0), 0);
      const sumC2 = parsedTotals?.c2 || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.c2 || 0), 0);
      const sumC2MJ = parsedTotals?.c2mj || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.c2mj || 0), 0);
      const sumAbono = parsedTotals?.abono || contrastedAliados.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.abono || 0), 0);
      const sumPagos = parsedTotals?.pagos || (sumC2 + sumC2MJ);

      const updatedTeam = {
        ...currentTeamAliados,
        hasSheetContrast: true,
        sheetUrl: cleanSheetUrl || currentTeamAliados.sheetUrl || null,
        metrics: {
          ...currentTeamAliados.metrics,
          totalPersonas: sumPxSheet,
          desertores: sumDesertores,
          pxFin: sumPxFin,
          declaraciones: sumDecl,
          pasaronC2: sumPagos,
          pagaronC2: sumC2,
          pagaronC2MJ: sumC2MJ,
          abonos: sumAbono,
          efectividadPP: sumPxFin > 0 ? `${Math.round((sumPagos / sumPxFin) * 100)}%` : '0%',
          aliadosAsignados: contrastedAliados.length
        },
        aliados: contrastedAliados,
        feedbackQT: finalFeedbackQT,
        sheetTotals: {
          px: sumPxSheet,
          desertor: sumDesertores,
          pxFin: sumPxFin,
          declaracion: sumDecl,
          c2: sumC2,
          c2mj: sumC2MJ,
          abono: sumAbono,
          pagos: sumPagos,
          pp: sumPxFin > 0 ? `${Math.round((sumPagos / sumPxFin) * 100)}%` : '0%'
        },
        extraidoAt: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      await setDoc(doc(db, 'nodus_aliados', 'latest'), {
        equipos: {
          ...(aliadosData?.equipos || {}),
          [selectedEquipoId]: updatedTeam
        }
      }, { merge: true });

      setSheetSyncStatus(`✅ Contrastado y guardado para ${currentTeamAliados.equipoNombre}: ${contrastedAliados.length} Aliados y ${finalFeedbackQT.length} Quantums.`);
      setSheetPasteInput('');
    } catch (err) {
      setSheetSyncStatus(`⚠️ ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setSheetSyncLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const currentMetrics = currentTeamAliados.metrics || {
    totalPersonas: 96,
    pasaronC2: 24,
    pagaronC2: 18,
    pagaronC2MJ: 6,
    abonos: 11,
    aliadosAsignados: 17
  };

  const contabilidadMetricas = contabilidadData?.metricas || {
    pagosCerrados: 134,
    montoRecaudado: 'PEN 92,985.00',
    pagosPendientes: 0,
    totalParticipantes: 149,
    asistieronC1: 96,
    monedaDetectada: 'PEN'
  };

  const catalogList = catalogData?.modulos || [
    { path: '/aliados', title: 'Aliados & Conversión C1-C2', section: 'SEGUIMIENTO', category: 'aliados', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/contabilidad', title: 'Contabilidad & Recaudación', section: 'SISTEMA', category: 'finanzas', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/mesaregistro', title: 'Mesa de Registro', section: 'SEGUIMIENTO', category: 'registro', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/juniors', title: 'Juniors & Jóvenes', section: 'SEGUIMIENTO', category: 'juniors', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/participantes', title: 'Participantes / Facturación', section: 'SISTEMA', category: 'participantes', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/actividadcoordinadores', title: 'Actividad Coordinadores', section: 'REPORTES', category: 'coordinacion', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/reporteentrenadores', title: 'Reporte Entrenadores', section: 'REPORTES', category: 'entrenadores', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/reporte', title: 'Reporte Asistencia General', section: 'REPORTES', category: 'asistencia', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/certificados', title: 'Certificados & Diplomas', section: 'SEGUIMIENTO', category: 'certificados', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/documentos', title: 'Documentos Institucionales', section: 'SISTEMA', category: 'documentos', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/futurosimposibles', title: 'Resultados Imposibles', section: 'SEGUIMIENTO', category: 'metas', isKnown: true },
    { path: '/dashboard', title: 'Dashboard General Nodus', section: 'SISTEMA', category: 'core', isKnown: true }
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
      {/* Alerta de Confidencialidad y Enlace en Vivo */}
      <div style={{
        background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) 0%, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.12) 100%)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4)',
        borderRadius: '12px',
        padding: '1.2rem 1.5rem',
        display: 'flex',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        gap: '1rem'
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.8rem' }}>
          <div style={{
            width: '12px',
            height: '12px',
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: '#10b981',
            boxShadow: '0 0 10px #10b981',
            animation: 'pulse 2s infinite'
          }} />
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: '#10b981', fontSize: '0.95rem', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
                AGENTE EXTRACTOR NODUS EN TIEMPO REAL
              </span>
              <span style={{
                background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)',
                color: '#10b981',
                padding: '2px 8px',
                borderRadius: '6px',
```
